The Hub is format- and protocol-agnostic, exchanging data as CSV, XML, EDI or JSON over SFTP, AS2 or API, and offers API extensions that let pharma organisations connect internal systems to external suppliers with minimal IT effort. The platform is ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 9001:2015 certified and GDPR compliant. Veratrak is a Seedcamp portfolio company.

providers.name: Flight Network
providers.description: Flight Network (Flight Network Ltd, 145 King St. West Suite 2850, Toronto, Ontario, TICO Registration 50009248) is a Canadian online travel agency founded in 2005 and owned by Sweden's Etraveli Group since 2019. It retails flights plus hotels and car rentals to consumers across 75+ markets in 35 languages, sourcing air content through the GDSs - its own About Us page carries the Amadeus and Sabre marks and claims "IATA Certified Travel Agents" - and reaching buyers through its own sites, its iOS/Android apps, metasearch deep links from Skyscanner and Kayak, and third-party affiliate networks. It sits in the distribution chain as a retailer downstream of the GDSs and of its Etraveli sibling TripStack (the group's B2B LCC/NDC/virtual-interlining API), not as a content owner. Its API posture is honest and thin: no developer portal, no published API documentation, no machine-readable specification, and no exit path. developer/developers/docs/api.flightnetwork.com are all NXDOMAIN, /openapi.json and /swagger.json return 404, and the only machine-readable surfaces reachable are the consumer booking site, a security.txt pointing at security@etraveligroup.com, the iOS/Android app-link declarations, and - the one genuine find - a substantial provider-published llms.txt at the site root that hands agents a regional domain map, a product and ancillary catalogue, a support-escalation hierarchy, and explicit DO/DON'T directives for AI systems. Flight Network is thus addressable by agents as a referral target while remaining entirely uncallable. Any B2B or travel-seller access is arranged by commercial agreement off-web.

providers.name: JetBlue
providers.description: JetBlue Airways (IATA code B6) is a New York-headquartered low-cost United States carrier flying across the U.S., Caribbean, Latin America and Europe, with hubs and focus cities at JFK, Boston, Fort Lauderdale, Orlando and San Juan. In the travel distribution chain JetBlue sits as an inventory owner that sells through three channels: its own direct consumer surface (jetblue.com, the JetBlue app and the TrueBlue loyalty program), the legacy GDS channel where it files fares, seats and EMDs and settles through ARC in the U.S. and IATA BSPs internationally, and an IATA New Distribution Capability program that reaches agencies through GDS/NDC aggregators, corporate booking tools and online booking platforms. JetBlue publishes no public developer portal, no API reference and no downloadable OpenAPI or NDC schema: developer.jetblue.com, developers.jetblue.com and docs.jetblue.com do not resolve, api.jetblue.com answers 404 at every probed path, and the 361-URL public sitemap contains no developer or API page. The only published distribution surface is the travel-agent policy section at jetblue.com/travel-agents, including an NDC program page that states JetBlue supplies NDC API documentation, schema and message samples and certification guidelines to onboarded partners only, after business use-case submission, onboarding and certification testing. Selling JetBlue requires ARC accreditation in the U.S. or IATA accreditation plus local BSP participation abroad; JetBlue states it works with only a few OTAs and is not accepting new applications. Public docs, accreditation required, no self-serve access, and no exit path.

providers.name: Backerkit
providers.description: BackerKit is a crowdfunding and pledge-management platform for professional creators. It began as backer-survey and data-management software that helps creators who funded projects on Kickstarter and Indiegogo collect shipping addresses, sell add-ons and pre-orders, charge cards, and manage backer data for reward fulfillment. It has since grown into a full crowdfunding platform of its own, powering campaigns end to end and, in 2024, roughly one in every four dollars raised on Kickstarter. BackerKit is a Y Combinator company. It exposes integration API keys (API key, secret, and Store GUID) so creators can connect fulfillment services such as ShipStation, but it does not publish a public, self-serve developer API, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs; developer access is account-scoped and configured inside the BackerKit dashboard.

providers.name: TJX Companies
providers.description: The TJX Companies, Inc. is an American multinational off-price department store corporation headquartered in Framingham, Massachusetts, ranked No. 80 on the 2024 Fortune 500 list. Operating over 4,800 stores across nine countries and three continents under brands including T.J. Maxx, Marshalls, HomeGoods, Sierra, HomeSense (US), and Winners, HomeSense, Marshalls (Canada), TJX provides supplier and vendor integration through EDI and web-based portal platforms. Supplier connectivity is handled via Oracle iSupplier, SupplierOne, and the DiCentral ASN Vendor Portal, supporting purchase orders, advanced shipping notices, invoicing, and payment tracking.

providers.name: QXO Building Products
providers.description: QXO is a publicly traded company focused on building a tech-forward leader in the building products distribution industry through acquisitions and operational improvements. QXO offers a suite of customer-facing APIs for ordering, pricing, account management, product catalog, delivery tracking, and invoicing.

providers.name: SkySelect
providers.description: SkySelect is an AI-powered aircraft parts procurement platform for airlines, MROs (maintenance, repair and overhaul providers), and aircraft lessors. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Francisco, it operates an eProcurement-as-a-Service platform that automates sourcing, purchasing, and order tracking for aviation materials. Rather than a listings-based marketplace, buyers submit a demand list and SkySelect's specialised procurement AI automatically issues RFQs to a global network of 3,000+ verified suppliers, having processed more than US$6 billion in transactions. The platform exposes an integration API (inventory sync, RFQ reception, and quote submission) gated behind account login; partners such as Rotabull connect via API Key and Secret credentials generated in Developer Settings. SkySelect is backed by Initialized Capital and raised US$9M in 2026.

providers.name: Workrise
providers.description: Workrise - which returned to its original RigUp brand in September 2024 - is an Austin-based source-to-pay platform for the energy industry, combining vendor management, contingent workforce staffing, bid management, capital management, and field-service payments for upstream and midstream oil and gas operators. Backed by a16z and Founders Fund. The company publishes no public developer portal or API documentation; platform access is through accounts.rigup.com (OpenID Connect via Auth0), and its engineering org open-sources utilities at github.com/rigup.

providers.name: Swift Transportation
providers.description: Swift Transportation, now operating as Knight-Swift Transportation Holdings (KNX), is the largest full truckload motor carrier in North America. The company provides truckload, LTL, logistics, and intermodal transportation services across the US, Mexico, and Canada. Technology integration is primarily through EDI for freight tendering, shipment status, and invoicing workflows with trading partners and shippers.

providers.name: Public Sector
providers.description: Industry-vertical index for the public-sector / government API landscape across U.S. federal, state, and local levels. Catalogs the federal API gateway api.data.gov (operated by GSA's Technology Transformation Services under the Open Government Data Act of 2018, used by 25 agencies for over 450 APIs), the catalog.data.gov CKAN metadata catalog, headline federal programmatic surfaces (Regulations.gov, Federal Register, GovInfo, SAM.gov, USAspending.gov, Treasury Fiscal Data, Congress.gov, FEC openFEC, api.weather.gov, api.nasa.gov, Census Data API, Bureau of Economic Analysis), state and local infrastructure (Socrata / Tyler Data and Insights, Tyler Technologies courts/ERP/public-safety stack, OpenGov ERP/budgeting/permitting cloud), and the civic-tech layer (OpenStates / Plural Policy, GovTrack, Open Civic Data). Cross-references Kin Lane's 2026-05-05 roundup of 211 U.S. federal agencies and their APIs on apievangelist.com. The catalog focuses on the data-schema shape of a government dataset / agency / regulation record so that civic-tech and enterprise consumers can normalize across federal, state, and local publishers.

providers.name: Takealot
providers.description: Takealot is South Africa's largest online retailer and the flagship brand of the Takealot Group, a Cape Town-headquartered e-commerce holding company that is majority-owned (approximately 96%) by Naspers through its consumer-internet arm Prosus. The Group operates a connected ecosystem of consumer brands — Takealot.com (general merchandise marketplace), Mr D (on-demand food and grocery delivery), Superbalist.com (fashion and homeware, divested in September 2024 to a South African consortium led by Blank Canvas Capital but historically associated with the Group), and TFS (Takealot Fulfilment Services, the Group's first- and last-mile logistics arm) — and employs more than 7,300 people across South Africa. Takealot.com itself is a 1P-plus-3P hybrid marketplace where Takealot Retail sells its own inventory alongside thousands of third-party Marketplace sellers; sellers list, price, fulfil, and analyse their offers through the Seller Portal at seller.takealot.com and programmatically via the public Takealot Seller API. The Seller API is the company's primary external developer surface — a Swagger 2.0 / OpenAPI REST API at seller-api.takealot.com that exposes offer management (single and 10,000-item batch create / update / patch), stock-health and storage-fee diagnostics, and sales / order / customer-invoice reporting, authenticated with per-seller API keys minted from the Seller Portal and governed by per-key rate-limit headers (x-RateLimit-Limit / Remaining / Reset). There is no public buyer-side / catalog / consumer-facing API, no published OAuth flow, no webhook surface, no SDKs, no CLI, and no developer Slack / forum; the Group's GitHub presence (TAKEALOT org) is a small set of archived infrastructure forks (Diamond, statsite, kafka-connect-bigquery, protoc-gen-bq-schema, Newtonsoft.Json, Lithium) rather than a maintained developer platform. The Seller API is the integration point that powers South Africa's marketplace-listing tool ecosystem (Stock2Shop, Wherehouse, Flowgear, OrderEazi, and similar) and is the canonical artifact to profile for any Takealot capability work.

providers.name: Mercado Libre
providers.description: Mercado Libre is the largest e-commerce marketplace in Latin America with adjacent fintech (Mercado Pago), logistics (Mercado Envios), and ads businesses. The developer platform exposes REST APIs for items, orders, shipments, users, payments, and seller tooling.

providers.name: Pactum
providers.description: Pactum is an AI procurement negotiation platform that deploys autonomous agents to conduct commercial supplier negotiations at scale while enforcing buyer-defined policies and guardrails. Its agent suite spans requisition alignment and negotiation, tactical and post-sourcing sourcing, price-list, discount, payment-terms, and rebate negotiations, letting enterprise procurement teams reach agreements on long-tail spend that would otherwise go unnegotiated. Pactum is a venture-backed enterprise SaaS company; as of this profile it exposes no public developer API, so this record captures the company's identity plus its published security, trust, and disclosure surface.

providers.name: StatsBomb (Hudl)
providers.description: StatsBomb, now part of Hudl, supplies advanced football (soccer) analytics and data to professional clubs, federations, broadcasters, and media. The StatsBomb Data product captures 3,400+ events per match across 190+ competitions with proprietary models (Expected Goals, On-Ball Value, HOPS) and bundled player-location and 360 data. Delivery is sales-led through licensed client APIs and standard file formats (JSON, XML, CSV), with the StatsBomb Open Data set published publicly on GitHub for the research community.

providers.name: Traba
providers.description: Traba is a New York City-based staffing marketplace and AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain, founded in 2021 and backed by Founders Fund. Traba connects vetted, high-reliability light-industrial workers with production plants, warehouses, and distribution centers, and pairs that staffing marketplace with Neo, an AI intelligence layer that unifies live operational data across WMS, ERP, HRIS, TMS, and payroll systems, surfaces root causes, and automates approved supply chain workflows. Traba publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Valdera
providers.description: Valdera is the AI-powered sourcing and procurement platform for chemicals, ingredients, and raw materials, matching buyers with vetted global suppliers across a database of 400K+ suppliers and 1.7M+ unique chemistries. Buyers get supplier discovery, RFQs, and negotiation in one place; suppliers receive relevant inbound RFQs and fulfill orders on the platform. Valdera is a web platform, not an API provider — it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Hopstack
providers.description: Hopstack is an AI-native, cloud-based warehouse management system (WMS) and fulfillment operations platform that helps warehouses, 3PLs, and e-commerce operators optimize inbound logistics, inventory, order processing, picking, packing, shipping, and returns across channels. Hopstack exposes a documented RESTful API (referenced at apidocs.hopstack.io) for programmatic access to core resources such as orders and consignments, secured with a per-user X-API-Key generated from the Hopstack Dashboard. API access is gated - a customer must contact Hopstack Support to enable API-key generation in the UI - and the full endpoint surface, base URL, and machine-readable specification are published behind that account/partner reference rather than as a fully open catalog.

providers.name: Parspec
providers.description: Parspec is an AI-native platform for electrical, lighting, and MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) distributors and manufacturer rep agencies in the construction supply chain. It consolidates fragmented, manual workflows into one system covering quoting for complex projects, automated submittal and O&M document creation, project management (orders, fulfillment, billing), and sales management, with ERP integrations (Epicor Eclipse, Epicor Prophet 21, SAP). Parspec is SOC 2 Type II attested and markets itself to help distributors and rep agencies bid more, win more, and improve profitability. Backed by Threshold Ventures.

providers.name: easyJet
providers.description: easyJet Airline Company Limited is a British low-cost short-haul carrier registered in England (company number 03034606, registered office Hangar 89, London Luton Airport, Luton, Bedfordshire, LU2 9PF), flying a point-to-point network that its own trade pages describe as connecting more than 155 airports across 35 countries. Its home market is the United Kingdom and its commercial centre of gravity is intra-European leisure and short-haul business traffic, extended by the easyJet holidays package business and by ancillary products (seat selection, hold and large cabin bags, Flex, Pass Extra, Smart+, Inclusive and Inclusive Plus fare bundles). easyJet sits at the direct end of the airline distribution chain. It was built without a GDS dependency and still sells the overwhelming majority of its seats through its own website and app; agency and OTA access exists but is a controlled secondary channel rather than the primary rail. That channel is governed by a published Distribution Charter (version March 2026) which permits a Reseller to access easyJet Data in exactly two ways — "via an easyJet Approved Channel which has entered into an API agreement with easyJet" or "directly via the easyJet API, if the Reseller has a Direct API Agreement with easyJet" — and which explicitly forbids screen scraping and any other automated extraction. easyJet publishes the list of Approved Channels and a per-partner functionality matrix current to the end of May 2026: Amadeus, Anaxys, Bewotec, Duffel, JFA Systems, Kyte, Paxport, Peakwork, Sabre, Travelfusion, Travelport, Traveltek, Viaxoft and Ypsilon. Its API posture, stated honestly, is commercial-agreement-gated and undocumented. There is no developer portal — developer, developers, docs, apis, ndc, partner, partners, trade, agent, sandbox, dev, portal, connect and xml subdomains of easyjet.com all fail to resolve — and no machine-readable contract of any kind is published: no OpenAPI, no Swagger, no AsyncAPI, no GraphQL schema, no security.txt, no llms.txt and no .well-known API catalogue. Two real API hostnames do exist, api.easyjet.com and b2b.easyjet.com, but both sit behind Akamai and return HTTP 403 Access Denied on every path probed. Just as importantly, easyJet is not an NDC carrier: the March 2026 charter never mentions NDC, easyJet does not appear on ndctracker.com's list of 73 airlines with launched or in-development NDC programmes, and its aggregators describe the connection as a direct-connect API rather than an NDC one — Duffel labels it "Direct Connect". A reseller therefore integrates against a bilateral, proprietary, unpublished interface under an English-law contract that easyJet may amend without notice and under which it reserves the right to restrict, suspend or terminate access and to cancel bookings already made. A second enrichment pass on 2026-07-28 did find one live, anonymously reachable easyJet integration surface the first pass missed: the easyWidget / easyDom partner component platform at brand.easyjet.com, a hosted JavaScript widget service that partner and white-label sites embed for easyJet page chrome and for easyJet customer sign-in, registration and visitor recognition. It is undocumented, partner-scoped by a query-string partner identifier and built on legacy jQuery, but it is real and it is the only easyJet interface that answers a stranger with a 200. The REST hostnames stay closed, and this record stays honest about the difference: only what can be verified is catalogued, and an Akamai-gated hostname is still not listed as an API.

providers.name: Maersk
providers.description: A. P. Moller-Maersk is a Danish integrated logistics and container shipping company and one of the world's largest container shipping lines. Maersk operates ocean transport (Maersk Line), port and terminal operations (APM Terminals), supply-chain management, air cargo (Maersk Air Cargo), inland services, and customs solutions, connecting ports across more than 130 countries with end-to-end supply chain offerings. Maersk operates a public developer portal at developer.maersk.com that hosts APIs for shipping customers and partners covering tracking, schedules, rates, bookings, and related logistics workflows.

providers.name: Nowlun Holding Corp.
providers.description: Nowlun is a digital freight-forwarding platform serving the Middle East and North Africa that lets businesses compare instant ocean-freight quotes from 30+ shipping lines, book FCL and bulk sea shipments, arrange inland trucking to and from ports, track cargo through transit, and handle customs clearance. Beyond its shipper-facing web application, Nowlun operates a live, OAuth-protected Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at https://nowlun.com/mcp, secured with RFC 8414 authorization-server and RFC 9728 protected-resource discovery (Authorization Code + PKCE, "mcp" scope). Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Orolabs
providers.description: ORO Labs provides an agentic procurement orchestration platform for enterprise spend management. It coordinates people, processes, systems, and data so employees can get what they need without friction, unifying intake management, supplier onboarding and lifecycle, risk and compliance orchestration, and AI-driven workflow automation. The platform offers a no-code workflow builder, a purpose-built agent builder for custom procurement AI agents, and bring-your-own-LLM flexibility, with secure, semantically rich integrations across the procuretech landscape. ORO Labs is backed by Felicis and Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: Huice
providers.description: Huice (慧策) is a Chinese enterprise software company whose flagship product, Wangdiantong (旺店通) ERP, is a tailor-made e-commerce management system for merchants operating across multiple online channels. It provides order management, warehouse and inventory management (WMS), goods and product-archive management, procurement, after-sales/returns processing, and financial operations (慧经营). Huice runs a public Open Platform (open.wangdian.cn) exposing an HTTP API (openapi2) for third-party integrators to synchronize shops, goods, orders, stock, purchasing, and logistics. The API uses a sid + appkey + timestamp + MD5 signature (sign) authentication scheme, page_no/page_size pagination, and a code/message response envelope, with separate sandbox and production hosts.

providers.name: xChange
providers.description: Container xChange is a Hamburg-founded B2B online marketplace and operating platform for shipping containers, where container owners, users, traders, and lessors buy, sell, and lease standard and special containers worldwide. The platform covers container trading, one-way and long-term leasing, payment handling via the xChange Wallet, insurance, container tracking, and market-price insights, plus a live North America container inventory storefront. xChange publishes no public developer API; its xChange Connect integrations (customer supply-listing feeds and depot container-movement reporting) accept data via API or spreadsheet but are onboarded privately through an account manager.

providers.name: AtoB
providers.description: AtoB is a fleet payments platform for the trucking and transportation industry, offering fuel cards, spend-management controls, driver payouts, and trip credit to fleets of every size. Its cards work across a nationwide fuel network with truck-stop discounts, granular purchase controls (fuel-only, category/MCC restrictions, per-transaction and daily limits), telematics-aware fraud prevention, and reporting that supports IFTA fuel-tax and expense compliance. AtoB also runs partner programs for factoring companies, freight brokers, and merchants, and exposes a private Partners API used by telematics and fleet-management integrations (for example Fleetio and Oxmaint) to sync cards, drivers, vehicles, and settled fuel transactions. AtoB was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and General Catalyst; this profile has been enriched from public web sources.

providers.name: FleetMon
providers.description: FleetMon was a Rostock, Germany based vessel tracking and maritime data provider (founded 2007) that operated one of the world's largest terrestrial AIS receiver networks and a documented REST API (apiv2.fleetmon.com) for vessel search, live and historical AIS positions, port calls, expected arrivals, ETA and voyage planning. Kpler acquired FleetMon alongside MarineTraffic in 2023, the FleetMon platform and API were phased out from January 2024 and migrated into MarineTraffic, and in September 2025 the combined AIS assets were unified under the Kpler AIS brand. As of 2026 the fleetmon.com domain, developer portal, and API no longer resolve - this entry preserves the final archived API surface and points to the Kpler / MarineTraffic successor services.

providers.name: Settle
providers.description: Settle is a financial operations platform built for consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands and ecommerce companies, unifying procurement, accounts payable automation, and working capital financing in one back office. Teams create and manage purchase orders, track goods received and true landed costs, collect and approve bills, pay vendors with real-time visibility, and access flexible inventory and growth financing ($20K-$15M) underwritten from payables and purchasing data. Founded in 2019 and backed by Ribbit Capital, Kleiner Perkins, and Founders Fund, Settle has funded more than $3 billion to brands. A developer API covering bill pay, payments, and landed-cost data is in early access via a public waitlist.

providers.name: BT Group
providers.description: BT Group plc (British Telecommunications) is the United Kingdom's largest fixed-line, broadband, and mobile communications provider, headquartered in London with operations spanning consumer, business, wholesale, and global enterprise markets. The group is organised around three customer-facing brands — BT, EE, and Plusnet — and a wholesale division that sells capacity and access to other communications providers. BT Group operates the UK's largest mobile network (EE), runs fibre and copper access through Openreach (a legally separate group company), and provides networked IT and security services to multinational enterprises and the UK public sector. The group publishes a public developer programme at developer.bt.com that exposes a growing catalogue of REST APIs across two main domains: charging and crediting (Direct Carrier Billing, Crediting, Premium SMS) and digital identity / fraud prevention (SIM Swap, Network Identity, Call Divert Protection), alongside wholesale and operational APIs (Broadband One, Quote Management, Address Management, Appointment Management, Product and Network Availability, HubCo Voice, Global Voice Services, IMEI Lookup, Home Network, Rail Insights, Location Insights for London, and a Travel Journey API Platform). The portal supports sandbox onboarding with Client ID / Client Secret OAuth 2.0 credentials and progression to production under a commercial agreement with an account team. In April 2025 BT announced a federated API management partnership with Kong (Kong Konnect) to consolidate its previously fragmented API estate, strengthen governance, and offer a self-service developer experience across the group.

providers.name: Dealer.com
providers.description: Dealer.com, a Cox Automotive brand, builds automotive dealership websites, digital advertising, and digital marketing technology used by thousands of franchise and independent dealers across North America. Its integration surface is partner-gated: third parties embed experiences on dealer sites through the Dealer.com Website Integration API and the Integrated Partner Program, while inventory, leads, deal, and digital-retail data flow through the broader Cox Automotive Integration Platform (developer.coxautoinc.com), which uses OAuth (Okta) and requires an approved partner agreement. Dealer.com does not publish an open, self-serve public API; the endpoints modeled here are logical groupings of the partner capabilities, not a documented public surface.

providers.name: Brickanta
providers.description: Brickanta is a Stockholm-based agentic AI platform built for the construction industry, deploying specialized AI agents to automate pre-construction and project workflows including bid analysis, cost estimation, procurement package generation, document and contract review, compliance, and quality assurance. The platform reads drawings, specs, and contracts to surface risks and gaps, turns raw RFPs into discipline-specific procurement packages, and builds a searchable knowledge base from every finished project. Brickanta raised an $8M seed round led by Northzone in early 2026 and serves construction teams across eleven countries. The company exposes a customer application and a public trust portal but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference; this profile captures its identity and security posture.

providers.name: Lineage
providers.description: Lineage, Inc. (Nasdaq: LINE) is the world's largest temperature-controlled warehousing and logistics REIT, operating a global cold-chain network of more than 480 facilities across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. It provides cold storage and automated warehousing, blast freezing, food manufacturing and processing support, direct-to-consumer fulfillment, and an integrated transportation arm spanning freight forwarding, customs brokerage, drayage, temperature-controlled rail, managed transportation and multi-vendor consolidation. Its customer-facing technology is Lineage Link, a supply chain platform providing real-time visibility into inventory, orders, appointments and shipment status across the facility network, supported by proprietary systems including the Sybil warehouse-optimization algorithm and the Lineage Eye computer-vision receiving system. Lineage publishes no public API, developer portal or API documentation as of 2026-07-19; customer integration runs through Lineage Link and account teams rather than a self-service developer program. This profile therefore captures the verified identity, discovery and domain-security surface rather than an API contract.

providers.name: Optimal Dynamics
providers.description: Optimal Dynamics is the Decision Company for trucking. Its Transportation Decision System (TDS), CORE.ai, applies Artificial Decision Intelligence — born from 40 years of research at Princeton University — to automate and optimize strategic, tactical, and real-time planning for enterprise truckload carriers. The platform spans dispatch management, network management, bid analysis, and network simulation, using dynamic forecasting to simulate downstream impacts and drive highly automated operations that increase revenue per truck and reduce manual planning. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners.

providers.name: Platform Science
providers.description: Platform Science is an enterprise connected-vehicle and fleet management platform for commercial trucking and transportation. It combines ELD and telematics, driver applications (Hours of Service, DVIR, navigation, workflow, media management), back-office fleet management, and video safety intelligence on a single connected-vehicle platform. Its Virtual Vehicle Marketplace hosts 100+ partner integrations across 18 categories (asset tracking, compliance, fuel, navigation, sensors, TMS, and more), and a gated developer program (the Remote Platform Management system, an Android SDK, and a data-retrieval API governed by SPEED Certification) lets partners build edge and cloud integrations against the platform.

providers.name: Mienvío
providers.description: Mienvío is a Mexican logistics control-tower platform that unifies multiple parcel carriers behind a single multi-carrier shipping API and dashboard for e-commerce, retail, marketplace, and fintech shippers across Latin America. It compares carrier rates, automates routing by cost, SLA, and coverage zone, generates shipping labels, and provides real-time tracking, delivery-incident management, and post-purchase customer notifications. Merchants integrate through the REST API (api.mienvio.mx/v2) or prebuilt Shopify and WooCommerce connectors, shipping nationally, internationally, and locally across Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru, Guatemala, and El Salvador.

providers.name: Qualifyze
providers.description: Qualifyze is a supplier risk management and audit platform for the life sciences and pharmaceutical industries. It helps quality, procurement, and compliance teams qualify suppliers faster, run and manage GxP audits globally, and monitor supplier risk continuously. Its Audit Management Platform streamlines audit execution, CAPA management, and real-time visibility with access to a shared library of 5,000+ audit reports, while its Quality Insights Platform layers AI-driven predictive risk monitoring on top of the supply chain. Qualifyze is a delivered SaaS product for enterprise life-sciences customers; it exposes no public developer API, portal, or documentation at this time. The company publishes ISO 9001, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 compliance posture.

providers.name: VendorPM
providers.description: VendorPM is a PropTech procurement and vendor-lifecycle-management platform for the commercial real estate industry, unifying vendor credentialing, compliance screening, eTendering/eBidding, procurement, and contract management under a single login. Its marketplace connects property managers with a network of 50,000+ vendors to fulfill building services and contracts of all sizes, while an AI Procurement CoPilot surfaces recommendations and a Yardi Voyager ERP integration syncs vendor compliance and profile data. VendorPM serves 100+ property management groups and 6,000+ buildings across the US and Canada. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company; VendorPM exposes no public self-serve developer API — its Yardi/ERP integration is provisioned through a Customer Success Manager.

providers.name: A-Mark Precious Metals
providers.description: A-Mark Precious Metals is a full-service precious metals trading company that wholesales gold, silver, platinum, and palladium bullion and coins to dealers, financial institutions, and investors. They operate trading desks 17 hours daily across global locations (US, Asia, Vienna) and offer wholesale sales, direct-to-consumer, logistics and storage, minting, and collateralized loans services.

providers.name: Entelo
providers.description: Entelo is an AI-powered talent-sourcing and recruiting-automation platform for finding, engaging, and hiring candidates using predictive analytics, diversity-aware search, and candidate-engagement tooling. Entelo was acquired and is now delivered as "Entelo Recruit" within Rival (rival-hr.com), an AI-powered HR orchestration suite spanning recruiting, workflow, learning, and performance. Its former domain entelo.com now 301-redirects to Rival. No public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI is currently published for the Entelo/Rival Recruit product.

providers.name: Exotec
providers.description: Exotec is a French warehouse automation manufacturer and integrator, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Croix, France, that builds the Skypod robotic automated storage and retrieval system (AS/RS) and the Deepsky warehouse execution system (WES) that orchestrates it. Skypod combines autonomous three-dimensional mobile robots, modular racking, picking workstations and inbound exchangers into an all-in-one goods-to-person system; Deepsky is the software layer that coordinates the robots, stations and third-party equipment and connects the installation to a customer's WMS or WCS over a RESTful web-services interface. Exotec reports more than 10,000 robots deployed across over 200 customer sites for more than 50 brands including Decathlon, Renault Group, DSV, Carrefour, Gap and Uniqlo, serving apparel, general merchandise, aftermarket parts, grocery, third-party logistics and healthcare fulfillment. The Deepsky WMS integration interface is delivered as customer-specific documentation under a commercial deployment rather than a public developer program, so Exotec publishes no open developer portal, API reference or SDK. It does publish an llms.txt at its web root and holds ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification and SOC 2 Type 2 compliance.

providers.name: American Axle and Manufacturing
providers.description: American Axle & Manufacturing (AAM), now operating as Dauch Corporation following the February 2026 acquisition of Dowlais Group (GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy), is a global Tier 1 automotive supplier designing, engineering, and manufacturing driveline and metal forming technologies for electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. AAM operates an iSupplier Portal for supplier communication, EDI integration for forecasts and releases, and the Demand AAM aftermarket parts portal.

providers.name: Sweep
providers.description: Sweep is an enterprise carbon and ESG data management platform helping large organizations measure, manage, report, and reduce their carbon emissions and broader sustainability performance across Scope 1, 2, and 3 following the GHG Protocol. Its platform centralizes sustainability data across an organization and its value chain to produce audit-ready data from a single source, covering carbon accounting, ESG disclosure, value-chain engagement with supplier portals and automated data collection, audit and assurance trails, and business intelligence with dashboards and scenario modeling. Sweep supports compliance with the CSRD, ISSB, GRI, CDP, SFDR, TCFD, UK SRS, the GHG Protocol, and US state regulation including California SB 253 and SB 261, with vertical solutions for asset managers, asset owners, private markets, banks, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, energy, and consumer goods. Sweep was named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape 2026 for Carbon Management and recognized in the Verdantix 2026 Green Quadrant. The platform exposes data ingestion via API and SFTP and integrates with ERP, procurement, and HRMS systems, but Sweep does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or open-source repos — API access is delivered through customer engagements rather than a self-serve developer surface.

providers.name: Virgin Australia
providers.description: Virgin Australia (IATA code VA, ASX:VGN) is Australia's second-largest airline group, founded in 2000 and headquartered in Brisbane, operating a domestic and short-haul international network alongside charter and cargo services with more than 8,000 team members and the 13-million-member Velocity Frequent Flyer loyalty program. It sits on the airline side of a concentrated Australian duopoly with Qantas, and reaches travel agents and travel management companies almost entirely through GDS intermediation — Amadeus, Sabre and Travelport/Galileo — rather than through any direct machine interface of its own. Virgin Australia selected Sabre as its preferred NDC IT technology provider in October 2023 and renewed a multi-year Amadeus distribution agreement covering EDIFACT today and NDC in future, but as of July 2026 no Virgin Australia NDC endpoint, developer portal or API documentation is published anywhere on virginaustralia.com. Its API posture is honestly stated as none-published: developer.virginaustralia.com, developers., api., apis. and docs. subdomains do not resolve; /developers, /api, /api-docs, /openapi.json and /swagger.json all return 404; and the only partner surface is the Agency Hub, whose Travel Agent Main Agreement requires current IATA or ATIS accreditation, GDS access for BSP sales, and Virgin Australia's absolute discretion to approve an account. The one genuinely public programmatic-adjacent surface is the Virgin Australia app in ChatGPT, launched 10 June 2026 for flight and Velocity Reward Seat search only — it cannot book, amend, cancel or take payment, and its underlying interface is not documented.

providers.name: Continuum
providers.description: Continuum (gocontinuum.ai) is an AI-powered platform that automates B2B returns, warranties, and repairs for distributors and manufacturers. It handles the post-sales workflow end to end through four solution hubs: a Customer Hub with self-service warranty and return portals, a Warehouse Hub for one-click receiving, inspection and dispute processing, a Vendor & Finance Hub for automated vendor engagement and accounts-receivable management, and a Manufacturer Warranty Hub for warranty claim automation. The company reports outcomes such as a 70% reduction in returns labor cost, a 30% increase in profitability, and an 8% reduction in customer churn. Continuum integrates with major distribution ERP systems (Infor, NetSuite, Epicor, Oracle, Acumatica). Based in Chicago, it is seed-funded and backed by Cowboy Ventures. Continuum is SOC 2 audited and publishes a public trust center. No public developer API or documentation is available at this time.

providers.name: DP World
providers.description: DP World is an Emirati global logistics company that specializes in port operations, maritime services, and supply chain solutions. It manages and operates marine and inland terminals across more than 40 countries and operates a portfolio of digital platforms - including the CARGOES suite (Flow, Runner, TOS+, PCS, Customs), Searates, and the Digital Freight Alliance - that expose APIs and integrations for shipment visibility, freight pricing, terminal operations, and trade workflows.

providers.name: Leah
providers.description: Leah, formerly ContractPodAi and legally ContractPod Technologies Limited, is a London-headquartered enterprise agentic AI company that unifies contract lifecycle management, legal transformation, procurement, and finance operations into a single autonomous system. Its Leah Agentic OS platform provides skills-based orchestration, agentic workflows, a natural-language app builder, a library of domain-specific legal, contracting, procurement, and finance agents, and the Leah Maestro enterprise orchestrator. Leah is a five-time Gartner CLM Visionary, is SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, and is used by enterprises including PwC, KPMG, Philips, Alaska Airlines, MUFG, and Cushman & Wakefield. Leah ships pre-built connectors and describes open REST APIs for enterprise integration, but maintains no public developer portal or published API reference — API access is unlocked through the enterprise contract.

providers.name: Operation Support Equipment
providers.description: API for managing and accessing operation support equipment data, inventory, maintenance records, and deployment information for operational logistics and equipment lifecycle management.

providers.name: AutoZone
providers.description: AutoZone is the nation's leading retailer and a leading distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories with more than 7,000 stores across the Americas. AutoZone serves both do-it-yourself (DIY) customers and professional automotive service providers (DIFM) through retail stores, e-commerce, and electronic ordering integrations for commercial accounts via AutoZone Pro.

providers.name: Logility
providers.description: Logility is an AI-powered supply chain planning platform providing solutions for demand sensing, inventory optimization, supply planning, S&OP process management, and supply chain analytics. Part of Aptean, Logility serves 600+ clients across 80 countries with capabilities for demand planning, inventory optimization, scenario planning, manufacturing execution, and supplier management across 12+ industry verticals.

providers.name: Makersite
providers.description: Makersite is an AI-powered Product Lifecycle Intelligence platform that helps manufacturers manage product sustainability, cost, and compliance by connecting products to deep-tier supply chain, material, and chemical data. The platform automates lifecycle assessments (LCA) and product carbon footprint (PCF) calculations, supports eco-design and cost optimization, and produces regulatory reporting such as EU Taxonomy and CBAM. It integrates with enterprise CAD, ERP, and PLM systems (PTC Windchill, Siemens Teamcenter, Autodesk, ANSYS). Makersite is a portfolio company of Partech. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: OrderCircle
providers.description: OrderCircle is a B2B wholesale order management software platform, founded in 2015 in San Francisco, that gives fast-growing brands one system to automate wholesale orders, track inventory in real time, generate invoices, and run a self-service B2B eCommerce portal for their buyers. It targets wholesale operations in apparel, coffee, jewelry, food and beverage, hemp, vape, and CBD, and connects to existing tools through pre-built integrations with Shopify, WooCommerce, QuickBooks, Xero, ShipStation, Stripe, Square, PayPal PayFlow, and Authorize.Net. OrderCircle does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; its programmatic surface is limited to its packaged third-party integrations. This profile was seeded as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public web presence.

providers.name: Pango
providers.description: Pango is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building an AI-powered operating system for e-commerce post-purchase and logistics operations. The platform positions itself as an "agentic OS" — autonomous AI agents that handle back-office logistics tasks — and consolidates multi-carrier delivery management, checkout delivery options, branded order tracking, and returns processing into a single unified system. Pango advertises multi-carrier orchestration across 100+ shipping providers with AI-powered routing and rate optimization, self-service return portals with automated approvals, warehouse pick-and-pack automation, and AI agents that resolve exceptions and automate workflows. It integrates with major commerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento, Salesforce Commerce, NetSuite) and 100+ carrier, WMS, marketing, and support partners. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Y Combinator portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass the company markets an "API-first architecture" but publishes no public developer documentation, API reference, OpenAPI spec, or SDK.

providers.name: Vetcove
providers.description: Vetcove is a free purchasing and procurement platform for veterinary clinics and animal-health organizations that lets a practice shop every distributor and manufacturer at once. It consolidates accounts from suppliers such as Henry Schein, Patterson Vet, MWI, and Midwest Veterinary into one interface where staff compare live pricing and availability, place and track orders, and manage inventory across vendors without changing existing supplier relationships. The service is delivered as a web application and mobile app and is free to veterinary clinics and nonprofits. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Govini
providers.description: Govini (rebranded to Air, air.ai, in 2026) is a defense-technology and decision-analytics company whose Ark platform combines proprietary defense acquisition data with AI-enabled applications to close the national-security "Readiness Gap" across supply chain, science and technology, production, sustainment, logistics, and modernization missions. Ark holds FedRAMP High authorization and a DISA Impact Level 5 (IL5) Provisional Authorization plus service-level IL5 ATOs, making it a closed, government-authorized SaaS platform rather than a public developer API. Led by CEO Tara Murphy Dougherty and backed by investors including Accel and Bain Capital. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and has been enriched with the provider's real public identity, security posture, and published compliance authorizations.

providers.name: Airbase
providers.description: Airbase is a modern spend management platform for finance teams that combines accounts-payable (AP) automation and bill pay, guided procurement and purchase orders, corporate cards, and expense reimbursements on a single system with real-time general-ledger sync. Airbase Inc. was acquired by Paylocity in a ~$325M deal announced September 4, 2024 and completed October 1, 2024, and now operates as "Airbase by Paylocity," extending Paylocity's HCM suite into the office of the CFO. Airbase exposes a developer platform at developer.airbase.io (REST API reference, OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman and Insomnia collections, a webhooks management API, an OAuth playground, and a sandbox) used to build custom connections for systems not covered by the pre-built integrations. API access is account-gated - credentials are generated inside the customer's Airbase/Paylocity tenant rather than through open self-serve signup - so the logical APIs below are honestly modeled from the documented product surface and developer portal, and the exact endpoint paths and base URL are not publicly reproduced here (endpointsModeled).

providers.name: DeepStream Technologies
providers.description: DeepStream Technologies (deep.stream) is a London-based AI-enhanced eSourcing and source-to-contract platform for mid-market procurement teams. It digitalizes buyer-to-supplier sourcing with best-of-breed eRFx, supplier discovery, supplier pre-qualification, eAuctions, contract management, management reporting, and AI-driven RFP generation and conversational analytics, aiming to help procurement teams work faster, reduce risk, and gain visibility while keeping implementation simple. Customers include Walkers Shortbread, BrewDog, Abbott, and Free Now. DeepStream does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer documentation; integrations with ERP and PO systems are delivered as a service. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched with public company and infrastructure signals.

providers.name: Finaloop
providers.description: Finaloop is a real-time, ecommerce-native bookkeeping and accounting platform for direct-to-consumer (DTC) and multichannel brands. It replaces QuickBooks/Xero, human bookkeepers, and integration tooling with automation plus a team of ecommerce accounting experts, delivering always-current financials. Finaloop continuously syncs sales, returns, fees, reimbursements, inventory movements, COGS, and banking across 60+ ecommerce, marketplace, payment, banking, lending, and 3PL integrations (Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, PayPal, Stripe, Chase, ShipBob, and more) to produce real-time P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statements, inventory analytics, and tax services. Finaloop exposes no public developer API; its APIs are internal connectors to source platforms, so this profile is identity- and posture-focused rather than spec-bearing.

providers.name: Odeko
providers.description: Odeko is a cafe operations platform that keeps independent coffee shops and cafes stocked by combining predictive ordering, overnight supply delivery, and mobile ordering plus rewards management through a single dashboard. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GGV Capital and Y Combinator and added to the API Evangelist network. Odeko publishes no first-party developer API; its public odeko.com storefront runs on Shopify, which provisions agentic-commerce surfaces (llms.txt, UCP profile, and a UCP shopping MCP endpoint) on the domain. This profile captures those real domain artifacts.

providers.name: CF Industries Holdings
providers.description: CF Industries Holdings is a Fortune 500 American manufacturer and distributor of nitrogen-based fertilizers (ammonia, urea, ammonium nitrate, UAN) and clean-energy products serving agricultural and industrial customers worldwide. CF operates one of the largest global ammonia production networks and is scaling clean (blue and green) ammonia for low-carbon energy. CF does not publish a public developer API program; programmatic data access is limited to investor-relations SEC filings feeds, press/news RSS, and partner EDI/B2B integrations with agricultural distributors, rail, terminal, and industrial customers.

providers.name: CO2 AI
providers.description: CO2 AI is an enterprise sustainability platform that helps organizations measure, reduce, and report carbon emissions across their entire value chain. It combines trustworthy emissions data, AI-powered workflows, and supply-chain collaboration to baseline and track Scope 1, 2, and 3 corporate footprints, compute audit-ready product carbon footprints (PCF) at scale across thousands of SKUs (PACT, TfS, PEF, ISO aligned), engage suppliers for primary data, and build decarbonization plans ranked by Marginal Abatement Cost. Backed by Partech and surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a climate-sector company profile. No public developer API is published as of this enrichment pass; the profile captures the company's security, trust, and legal surface.

providers.name: Fictiv
providers.description: Fictiv is a digital manufacturing and supply chain platform that connects engineering and hardware teams with a vetted global network of manufacturers to source custom mechanical parts. It provides instant online quoting, automated design-for-manufacturability (DFM) analysis, and end-to-end order visibility across CNC machining, injection molding, 3D printing, sheet metal, urethane casting, and compression molding — from rapid prototyping through full-scale production. Now part of MISUMI, Fictiv operates a quote-to-order web platform at app.fictiv.com; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Leaner Technologies
providers.description: Leaner Technologies (株式会社Leaner Technologies) is a Tokyo-based B2B SaaS company founded on February 22, 2019 by CEO Yusuke Ohira, operating under the mission "調達のスタンダードを刷新し続ける" (continuously renew the standard of procurement). It builds the "Leaner" (リーナー) cloud suite for corporate procurement and purchasing departments: Leaner購買 (purchasing), a purchase-to-pay system covering quotation, approval workflow, ordering, receiving and payment; Leaner sourcing, a quotation and sourcing workspace; Leaner Connect, an SRM supplier-relationship platform; plus procurement BPO and consulting services. The platform aggregates supplier and EC catalogs (including Amazon Business and MonotaRO) into cross-catalog search, and applies AI to classify purchasing data for indirect-spend visibility and cost optimization. The company holds ISMS ISO/IEC 27001:2013 / JIS Q 27001:2014 certification (registration JP21/080659, February 2021). Leaner publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or client SDKs as of this enrichment pass — its integration surface is delivered through partner catalog connections rather than a self-serve API program.

providers.name: Vallor
providers.description: Vallor (Board AI, Inc.) is an AI coworker for procurement, legal, and sales teams that puts contracts on autopilot. Val reads every contract across the existing stack, drafts redlines against a playbook, flags risks, monitors obligations, renewals, SLAs, and rebates against live ERP and AP data, and answers plain-English questions with citations back to the source clause. It connects to 1,000+ systems including SAP, NetSuite, Snowflake, Salesforce, Ironclad, Icertis, DocuSign, and Slack, and ships a first-party Claude Code / Cowork plugin marketplace with 32 agent skills and 9 background agents for contract management and strategic sourcing. SOC 2 Type II audited and GDPR compliant, with customer data staying in the customer tenant. Backed by Bloomberg Beta.

providers.name: vAuto
providers.description: vAuto is a Cox Automotive brand providing new and used vehicle inventory management, appraisal, pricing, and merchandising software for automotive dealers (ProfitTime GPS, Provision, Conquest, Stockwave). vAuto exposes partner-gated APIs through the Cox Automotive Integration Platform (developer.coxautoinc.com) - notably the vAuto Inventory API and the vAuto Appraisal API - that let authorized integrators programmatically read vehicle inventory, update list price, and create and access appraisals in the vAuto ecosystem. Access is not open self-service; integrators must be approved partners, authenticate via Cox Automotive Bridge ID / OAuth with an issued API key, and endpoint-level reference documentation is behind the partner developer portal login. Per-path endpoints below are modeled from the published product summaries, not copied from public reference docs.

providers.name: Brightfield
providers.description: Brightfield is an extended-workforce intelligence company whose TDX (Talent Data Exchange) and TDX AI platform give enterprises data, automation, and precision over contingent-labor and statement-of-work (SOW) spending across 100+ countries. Products include Rate Intelligence, Rate Card Manager, SOW Rate Insights, SOW Quality and Risk Analytics, Supplier Scorecard, and an ROI Dashboard, built on transaction-level data from 700+ companies and $500B+ of global spend. Founded and led by CEO Jason Ezratty and headquartered in Washington, DC, Brightfield is backed by Sapphire Ventures. The product is delivered as a login-gated SaaS application; no public developer API or documentation surface is published at this time.

providers.name: Choice Hotels
providers.description: Choice Hotels International (NYSE: CHH) is a United States hotel franchisor headquartered in North Bethesda, Maryland, operating 7,575 hotels with 656,825 rooms open across 49 states, the District of Columbia and 50 countries and territories as of December 31, 2025. Its brands include Comfort, Quality, Clarion, Sleep Inn, Econo Lodge, Rodeway Inn, MainStay Suites, Suburban Studios, WoodSpring Suites, Everhome Suites, Cambria Hotels, Ascend Hotel Collection and the Radisson Americas brands. Choice sits on the supply side of the travel distribution chain as a franchisor rather than an owner: its proprietary choiceEDGE central reservation system pushes rate, inventory and availability to ChoiceHotels.com, the Choice Privileges mobile apps, the global distribution systems (Sabre, Amadeus), the OTAs (Expedia, Booking.com) and metasearch (Kayak, Tripadvisor), while its proprietary choiceADVANTAGE property management system runs the majority of its franchised properties. API posture is honestly none-published — no public developer portal, no published API reference, no machine-readable contract, and no exit path. A TIBCO Mashery API gateway answers at api.choicehotels.com but every probed path returns ERR_596_SERVICE_NOT_FOUND, and developer.choicehotels.com is an unprovisioned Mashery CNAME returning 404 under a mashery.com certificate. All real integration is reached through gated franchisee and vendor channels (connect.choicehotels.com, choicecentral.com, the SkyTouch /CONNECT interface program) that require a commercial agreement.

providers.name: Meal Ticket
providers.description: Meal Ticket is a Boise, Idaho-based SaaS company (founded 2011) delivering profitability management software for the foodservice supply chain. Its TrackMax+ platform helps food distributors and suppliers manage rebates, allowances, trade programs, payments, and operator-level intelligence at line-item detail, while its MarketMan platform provides AI-powered inventory and food-cost management to 15,000+ restaurant locations across 55+ countries. Meal Ticket serves 100+ distributors and suppliers and processes $40B+ in annual sales and rebate volume. The company operates as a customer-facing SaaS with a single-sign-on login surface (OpenID Connect) but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Flock Freight
providers.description: Flock Freight is a freight technology company and licensed freight brokerage that pioneered shared truckload (STL) shipping through its FlockDirect service. Its AI-powered pooling technology algorithmically combines multiple partial shipments from different businesses into a single multi-stop full truckload, giving shippers truckload-level service, damage rates, and speed without paying for a full trailer, while cutting empty miles and carbon emissions. The platform provides automated spot rating via API, TMS integrations, and EDI connectivity (204/210/211/214/990/997) for shippers and carriers. Backed by GV and the SoftBank Vision Fund, the company is a certified B Corporation.

providers.name: Zone & Company
providers.description: Zone & Co (Zone & Company) is a NetSuite-native financial operations software vendor whose SuiteApp suite automates the back office across five product families - Quote to Cash (ZoneBilling billing and revenue recognition, ZonePayments Stripe integration), Procure to Pay (ZoneProcure, ZoneCapture, ZoneApprovals), Treasury (ZoneLiquidity cash forecasting, ZoneReconcile), Payroll Management (ZonePayroll, Employee Portal), and Record to Report (ZoneReporting on Power BI, Data Warehouse, ZoneExtract, Solution 7). The products are delivered as native Oracle NetSuite SuiteApps distributed through the SuiteApp Marketplace rather than as a standalone public developer API. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Foundation Building Materials
providers.description: Foundation Building Materials (FBM) is a leading North American distributor of interior building products — drywall, steel framing, acoustic ceilings, insulation, and complementary construction supplies — serving commercial and residential contractors across the United States and Canada. Headquartered in Santa Ana, California, FBM operates a national branch network and a unified customer ordering platform at myfbm.com (consolidating the legacy fbmsales.com, MyRIS, and MyFBM portals) along with iOS/Android mobile apps for contractors. In April 2025, FBM acquired KCG/Rew Materials, adding 800 employees and 45 distribution branches across 23 states. In August 2025, Lowe's announced an agreement to acquire FBM. Brand families operating under FBM include FBM, RIS, Pacific Source, and Unified Door. FBM does not currently expose any public developer APIs, OpenAPI documentation, partner integration program, SDK, or GitHub organization — its digital surface is limited to buyer-facing e-commerce (search, ordering, order tracking, quick-order PDF/photo ingestion via "Quick Order Entry") rather than a developer/integration product.

providers.name: Tacto
providers.description: Tacto (Tacto Technology GmbH) is a Munich-based AI procurement intelligence platform for manufacturing companies. It unifies internal ERP and engineering data with external market intelligence to power AI agents that automate procurement work across four areas: Supplier Intelligence (centralized supplier management with documents, evaluations and performance data), Spend & Cost Intelligence (spend analysis and savings identification), Sourcing Intelligence (AI-optimized RFQ and price inquiries) and Compliance Intelligence (automated regulatory and supply-chain due-diligence detection). Tacto is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and GDPR compliant with EU-only hosting and an audit log of every AI action. It does not publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures the company's corporate, security and compliance surface.

providers.name: Web Methods
providers.description: Web Methods (webMethods) is an enterprise integration platform pioneer, founded in 1996 by Phillip and Caren Merrick in Fairfax, Virginia to connect software applications in real time using web standards such as HTTP and XML. Its 2000 IPO was one of the largest first-day pops of the dot-com era. webMethods was acquired by Software AG in 2007 for $546 million, and its integration portfolio - now including webMethods.io Integration (iPaaS), API Gateway and API Management, the Developer Portal, B2B/EDI, messaging, managed file transfer, and event-driven integration - was acquired by IBM in July 2024 as IBM webMethods Hybrid Integration. Mayfield was an early venture backer of the company.

providers.name: Wholesail
providers.description: Wholesail is an all-in-one accounts receivable and B2B payments platform for food & beverage wholesalers, distributors, and service vendors. It helps vendors onboard customers, manage credit risk, automate collections, accept ACH and card payments, and drive autopay — all connected to the vendor's ERP or accounting system. Wholesail is a fintech company backed by Foundry Group. As of enrichment it publishes no public developer API; it integrates with ERP systems using their native API protocols, scheduled file exchange, and robotic process automation, and it partners with Stripe, Plaid, Modern Treasury, JP Morgan, and SVB for payment processing. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Anvyl
providers.description: Anvyl is a supply chain and production management platform (a "Production Hub") for consumer-brand and e-commerce companies, connecting brands with their suppliers to manage the purchase-order and manufacturing lifecycle in one place: issuing and tracking purchase orders, coordinating production milestones and tasks, managing suppliers and SKUs/products, and monitoring inbound shipments and logistics. Anvyl was acquired by Sage and now operates under the Sage umbrella. It exposes a token-authenticated REST API (api.anvyl.com/api/v1) documented via Stoplight, with resources such as purchase orders. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Redpoint Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Anvyl's live public developer surface.

providers.name: Faks
providers.description: Faks is a French SaaS platform that digitizes and streamlines the commercial relationships across the pharmacy ecosystem. It gives pharmacies, pharmacy groups (groupements), and laboratories a single place to manage supplier relationships, commercial claims and disputes (litiges), expired and returnable product handling, promotions, and sell-in / sell-out performance. Faks connects to pharmacy management systems (LGO), purchasing platforms, and accounting tools through its Konnect integrations to automate what has traditionally been manual, paper, and email-driven work between the ~18,000 pharmacies, ~100 groups, and ~500 laboratories it targets in France. The company is backed by Seedcamp. Faks does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and the enrichment surfaces that could be probed.

providers.name: IHG Hotels & Resorts
providers.description: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC (trading as IHG Hotels & Resorts) is a British asset-light hotel group headquartered at Windsor Dials, 1 Arthur Road, Windsor, Berkshire SL4 1RS, United Kingdom, with an Americas office at 3 Ravinia Drive, Atlanta, Georgia. Its own corporate site states 7,014 hotels and 1,035,589 rooms across more than 100 countries, around 400,000 colleagues, 20 brands and the IHG One Rewards loyalty programme (figures read from ihgplc.com on 2026-07-28). The brand portfolio spans Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Vignette Collection, Kimpton, Hotel Indigo, voco, HUALUXE, Crowne Plaza, EVEN Hotels, Holiday Inn, Holiday Inn Express, Holiday Inn Resorts, Holiday Inn Club Vacations, Garner, avid, Atwell Suites, Staybridge Suites, Candlewood Suites, IHG Army Hotels and Iberostar Beachfront Resorts. In the distribution chain IHG sits on the supply side as a franchisor and manager rather than an owner: it aggregates independently owned and operated properties into a single central reservation system and pushes that inventory out through its own ihg.com and app direct channels, through the three GDSs and their agency terminals, through OTAs and wholesalers, and through corporate and group channels. Critically, IHG does not run its own reservation platform any more. It announced a partnership with Amadeus in 2015 to build a cloud Guest Reservation System to replace HOLIDEX, its proprietary system in service since 1965, and migrated onto it across 2018 and early 2019 — so the hotel group most likely to be a lock-in vendor is itself a customer of a GDS company's platform, and group bookings land in Amadeus Delphi and Meeting Broker. Its API posture, stated honestly, is gated and undocumented. There is no live developer portal. The one that existed — PartnerConnect RoomService at pcroomservice.ihg.com, a TIBCO Mashery portal publishing five rate, availability and hotel-content APIs — is decommissioned: the hostname is NXDOMAIN on Google, Cloudflare and Quad9 resolvers as of 2026-07-28 and the Internet Archive holds no page capture after 2019. What remains live is partnerconnect.ihg.com (HTTP 200), an affiliate marketing programme whose signup routes to Commission Junction and which still advertises "access to real-time hotel rates, availability and hotel content API's" without linking to any technical resource. Real API hostnames exist — api.ihg.com CNAMEs to ihg.api.mashery.com with an sb-ihg.mashery.com sandbox, and apis.ihg.com, b2b.ihg.com, mcp.ihg.com, booking.ihg.com and concerto.ihg.com all sit behind Akamai — but every one returns 403 Access Denied or 401 on every path probed, including /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs and /.well-known/. No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL, WSDL, XSD, OpenTravel/OTA or HTNG reference is published anywhere by IHG. apis[] is deliberately empty: listing an Akamai-gated hostname or a decommissioned 2017 portal as a live API would be fabrication. The value of this record is the switchingCost block in review.yml, which captures what published IHG documents actually say about what it costs to leave — including the archived RoomService Terms of Use classing "API parameters" as Confidential Information and binding partners to the Master PartnerConnect Terms and Conditions plus the Six Continents Hotels E-commerce Master Service Agreement, and the current IHG One Rewards member terms stating that members whose accounts are cancelled "by IHG or by the Member, will forfeit all Points, Point vouchers, Reward Nights, and any other benefits associated with the account".

providers.name: Kabal
providers.description: Kabal is the energy industry's leading logistics management SaaS platform. Founded in Norway in 2011 (formerly Wellit), Kabal provides an integrated, cloud-native platform that manages cargo, marine, transport, personnel, warehouse, rig and installation logistics across both offshore and onshore operations for oil & gas operators. The platform spans planning, execution and optimization, plus cost and emissions tracking and KPI reporting, connecting operators with their suppliers and vessels to share business-critical logistics data. Kabal is trusted by energy supermajors including ExxonMobil, Shell, Chevron, BP, TotalEnergies, Equinor, Petronas, Repsol, Eni and ADNOC, with tens of thousands of users across dozens of countries. Kabal received a growth investment from Insight Partners in 2023.

providers.name: Sunlight
providers.description: Sunlight is an educational-spending platform that lets organizations fund learning for their people. Administrators create groups, invite registered or unregistered members, allocate a per-user education budget ("sunlight"), and let members place orders for courses, books and subscriptions from providers such as Amazon and Platzi, while an activity feed tracks what members join and buy. Its REST API is built on the JSON:API specification (media type application/vnd.api+json) with Bearer-token authentication, and exposes groups, group membership and invitations, per-user credit/budget transactions, orders, and activities. Sunlight was backed by Seedcamp and Speedinvest.

providers.name: Ordana
providers.description: Ordana provides AI agents that run wholesale order-desk operations for distributors, reading every order across email, fax, PDF, EDI, voice, SMS and chat, resolving exceptions, communicating with retailers, and closing orders directly into the customer's ERP. Four agents cover the surface: Desk (end-to-end order automation), Voice (inbound/outbound phone ordering), Predict (cart prediction and AOV optimization), and Chat (text/SMS ordering). Ordana sits as an intelligence layer on top of existing ERP and commerce systems via pre-built connectors, and exposes its capabilities through a gated REST API, Webhooks, an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server over HTTP/SSE with OAuth 2.0, and the A2A agent-to-agent protocol. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Pietra
providers.description: Pietra is an AI-powered commerce platform for fast-growing consumer brands and creators. It unifies sourcing, production, fulfillment, logistics, marketing, and operations in a single platform — giving brands access to a network of 40,000+ global suppliers and factories, integrated third-party (3PL) fulfillment infrastructure, AI assistants that automate content creation and affiliate/influencer campaigns, competitive intelligence and social listening, and e-commerce software to run a direct-to-consumer business. Founded in 2019 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). As of this profile, Pietra does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Shopventory
providers.description: Thrive by Shopventory is inventory management, catalog control, and reporting software for small and medium-sized retail, restaurant, and hospitality businesses. Founded in 2012 out of a San Diego boutique and a graduate of the Techstars Boulder accelerator, Shopventory syncs stock, sales, and cost-of-goods data across multiple locations and sales channels, and integrates with Square, Shopify, Clover, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, and QuickBooks Online. The platform offers barcode scanning, purchase-order automation, demand forecasting, bundles and component-level tracking, price-tag printing, and advanced custom reporting. The company operates as Thrive by Shopventory (thrivemetrics.com). Its former public developer API (apidocs.shopventory.com) is no longer resolvable, so this profile captures the company's live web, support, and integration surface plus probed domain-security posture rather than a public API specification.

providers.name: TemperPack
providers.description: TemperPack is a Richmond, Virginia based sustainable packaging manufacturer, founded in 2015 and a Certified B Corporation, that designs and manufactures curbside recyclable and compostable alternatives to expanded polystyrene (EPS) and single-use plastic for cold chain and protective shipping. Its three material platforms are ClimaCell, a starch-and-paper thermal liner for cold chain shipments; Green Cell Foam, a certified compostable starch-based insulation with EPS-level performance; and WaveKraft, paper-based cushioning produced on demand. Products span cushioning, mailers, qualified shippers and stock shippers, serving life sciences, food and beverage, pet and veterinary, wine, and packaging distribution customers from ISO 9001:2015 certified plants in Richmond VA, Lansing MI and Las Vegas NV, with in-house ISTA thermal and mechanical testing at its Proving Ground lab. TemperPack operates a customer portal for order tracking, thermal testing results, billing and WaveKraft analytics, and an e-commerce store, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition or developer portal as of August 2026.

providers.name: ACV
providers.description: ACV Auctions (NASDAQ: ACVA) operates the nation's largest online wholesale marketplace and daily auto auction platform, connecting franchise and independent dealers to buy and sell used vehicles. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Buffalo, New York, ACV pairs a mobile-first bidding app with third-party vehicle inspections and condition reports, real-time market data (ACV MAX and market insights), transportation logistics, and dealer floor-plan financing through ACV Capital. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; ACV does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Beatport
providers.description: Beatport is the leading online music store and streaming platform for electronic dance music DJs and producers, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Beatport sells high-quality downloads (lossless WAV, AIFF, and FLAC, plus AAC) of tracks, releases, and DJ tools across more than 150 electronic genres, and operates a subscription streaming tier — Beatport Streaming — that delivers catalog tracks directly into supported DJ applications and hardware including Pioneer DJ rekordbox, Serato DJ Pro, Denon DJ Engine DJ, Algoriddim djay, Virtual DJ, Traktor, and others through integration partners. The Beatport Group also operates Beatsource (open- format DJ streaming and download store), DJCity (open-format record pool), Beatport LINK and Beatsource LINK (in-app streaming for DJ software), BeatportAmp (distribution and rights management for labels, formerly Ampsuite), Plugin Boutique (audio software and plugin marketplace), Loopcloud (sample subscription for producers), Label Radar (demo submission), Beatport Live (live events and streaming), Beatportal (editorial and media), and the International Music Summit (IMS) industry conference. The company reports ten million registered users, eighty thousand labels, four hundred thousand artists, and four hundred million USD paid out to rights holders since launch. Beatport operates a v4 REST API at api.beatport.com governed by OAuth 2.0 (authorization-code grant) with an interactive Swagger-UI developer portal at /v4/docs/; access is gated to approved partners through the Beatport Partner Portal, and there is no public client-credentials tier for general developers. The API exposes the Beatport catalog (tracks, releases, artists, labels, genres, sub-genres, charts, playlists, my-beatport collections, holds, and DJ-oriented search filters such as BPM, key, and released-date) and is the same surface that powers the public beatport.com applications and third-party DJ-software integrations. Beatport does not publish a downloadable OpenAPI document, an official SDK, or a CLI; partner integration is brokered case-by-case through the Partner Portal and the business-development team.

providers.name: BevSpot
providers.description: BevSpot is a Boston-based food and beverage inventory management platform for restaurants, bars, and hospitality groups. The web application streamlines back-of-house operations including inventory counting, ordering, invoice management, recipe and menu costing, and sales-driven analytics. BevSpot ingests point-of-sale data through integrations with more than a dozen POS systems (Toast, Square, Clover, Lightspeed, SpotOn, NCR Aloha, Upserve, Brink, Lavu, and others), plus accounting and vendor connections (QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics GP, Ottimate, Fintech, US Foods, Sysco). It is a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures. BevSpot does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, commercial, and security surface.

providers.name: Epicor
providers.description: Epicor Software Corporation provides industry-specific enterprise resource planning software for manufacturing, distribution, retail, and service industries. Epicor Kinetic, the flagship ERP platform, exposes an Open REST API built on OData v4 that gives developers service-based access to all business objects, processes, reports, BAQs, and Epicor Functions using standard HTTP methods and API key authentication.

providers.name: CADDi
providers.description: CADDi is a Tokyo-headquartered manufacturing-technology company that builds an AI Data Platform for industrial manufacturers. Its two products, CADDi Drawer and CADDi Quote, aggregate scattered 2D engineering drawings and supply-chain data into a single searchable asset, offering keyword and drawing-similarity search, automatic extraction of dimensions, text and shapes, and AI-assisted quotation and sourcing.
