The platform serves procurement, engineering, sales, production, quality, and leadership teams across automotive, robotics, and precision-machinery sectors, and connects to ERP, CAM, CAD, and quality systems via batch and CSV imports. CADDi was surfaced as a portfolio company of Atomico and DCM Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. It does not currently publish a public developer API or SDK.

providers.name: AMPAworks
providers.description: AMPAworks builds AI-powered smart-shelf inventory management for healthcare and defense supply chains. Its platform pairs computer-vision cameras and rolling kiosks that image inventory to auto-count stock in real time with software that tracks supplies 24/7, automates reordering, and gives teams live visibility to prevent stock-outs. The company reports outcomes such as $15M in cost reduction, 25,000 hours saved on hand counting, and 72% fewer stock-outs across more than 28 healthcare and operational organizations. Backed by 500 Global, AMPAworks operates from offices in Santa Monica CA, Buffalo NY, Hackensack NJ, and Ann Arbor MI.

providers.name: Deep Rooted
providers.description: Deep Rooted.Co is a direct-to-consumer fresh produce brand operated by Clover Ventures Pvt. Ltd, a Bengaluru-based agritech company founded in 2018 that launched the Deep Rooted consumer brand in 2020. The company works with a network of small-scale farmers using greenhouse and hydroponic techniques within roughly 150km of Bengaluru and Hyderabad, providing agronomy support from seed to harvest and delivering fruits, vegetables, Indian staples and greens, exotic produce and an easy-cook range direct to households the morning after ordering. Deep Rooted is backed by Accel. It sells through a consumer web storefront and mobile apps; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification, so this profile captures company identity and web properties only.

providers.name: Vector.ai
providers.description: Vector.ai, now operating as Raft (raft.ai), is an AI-powered logistics automation platform for freight forwarders, customs brokers, and trade finance teams. The Raft Intelligence Engine layers organization data, contextual LLMs, orchestration, and specialized governed agents to automate document processing, invoice matching, data extraction, and exception handling across supply chain operations, reporting 20M+ tasks completed by AI agents and 5M+ shipments processed annually. Raft publishes no public developer API; the platform is an enterprise application that integrates with customers' TMS and ERP systems.

providers.name: Aumet
providers.description: Aumet is a MENA-based healthtech company building an AI-first procurement and pharmacy operating system for healthcare. Its platform connects pharmaceutical manufacturers, distributors, and pharmacies through a B2B marketplace and a suite of pharmacy software: Pulse (point-of-sale, inventory, and smart reordering for individual pharmacies), Chain (multi-branch pharmacy management), and Enterprise (solutions for government health systems and hospitals). The platform adds AI-powered demand forecasting, procurement automation, price transparency, and analytics, and reports serving 12,000+ pharmacies and 1,000+ suppliers across Jordan, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia with over $1B in gross merchandise value and millions of transactions annually. Aumet is backed by 500 Global and Techstars.

providers.name: Finkargo
providers.description: Finkargo is a Latin American foreign-trade commerce platform that helps importers overcome the operational and financial barriers to growing their import businesses. Its product suite spans Paga (alternative supplier financing with revolving USD credit lines and 30-150 day terms), Analiza (market-intelligence dashboards that turn trade data into strategic decisions), Verifica (global supplier verification for product quality and legitimacy), and Protege (warehouse-to-warehouse cargo insurance). Operating across Colombia and Mexico and backed by QED Investors, Finkargo digitizes the full import-operations lifecycle from evaluating suppliers and planning imports to financing, transport, and arrival. Finkargo does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this profile captures the company's public product, legal, and security surfaces.

providers.name: Flight Centre Travel Group
providers.description: Flight Centre Travel Group (ASX FLT) is a Brisbane-headquartered travel retailer and corporate travel manager, one of the largest agency groups in the world and by far the largest in its home market of Australia. It operates more than thirty brands across leisure retail (Flight Centre, Travel Associates, Cruiseabout, Aunt Betty, BYOjet, Envoyage, Scott Dunn, StudentUniverse), corporate travel management (FCM, Corporate Traveller, Stage and Screen, FCM Consulting) and wholesale supply (Discova, Infinity Holidays, Topdeck, Backroads Touring, TPConnects), with company-owned operations in twenty-four countries and licensed operations in roughly ninety more. Structurally it sits on the demand side of the travel distribution chain - it is an aggregator-reseller that buys airline, hotel, cruise and land content through the GDSs (Sabre and Amadeus), through NDC aggregators, and through direct supplier agreements, and resells it to consumers and corporate travel programmes. Its API posture is honestly assessed as none published - Flight Centre Travel Group operates no developer portal, publishes no API reference, no OpenAPI, and no partner API documentation on any of its brand domains, and probing developer, developers, docs and api subdomains of fctgl.com, fcmtravel.com and flightcentre.com.au returns no DNS record at all. The group's genuine machine-readable distribution asset is TPConnects, the Dubai NDC aggregator it holds a majority stake in, whose Iris and Astra APIs are described on public product pages but whose reference documentation sits behind a ReadMe login. Flight Centre and FCM were the first global travel management company to receive IATA NDC Level 4 certification for full offer and order management, yet no public NDC endpoint is exposed. There is no self-serve access gate and no bulk export - the only documented exit path is a personal-data subject access request through a OneTrust web form.

providers.name: Jala
providers.description: JALA is an Indonesian aquaculture technology company providing end-to-end solutions for the shrimp farming industry, describing itself as a fully connected system powered by data farmers can trust. It connects farmers, processors, and buyers through the JALA App for real-time pond monitoring and data analytics, the Baruni technology platform, farming supplies (post-larvae, feed, technical assistance), harvest and cold-chain logistics services, and traceable certified supply chains for processors and buyers. Backed by 500 Global, JALA operates a consumer/operator SaaS platform (app.jala.tech) rather than a public developer API program. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: Route
providers.description: Route is a post-purchase platform for e-commerce brands that helps merchants own the customer experience after checkout. Its core products are package protection (shipping insurance covering lost, stolen, or damaged orders), AI-driven returns that reduce refunds and returns fraud, and real-time order and package tracking for shoppers. Route serves both merchants and their customers through storefront widgets, a mobile app, and a developer API documented on Stoplight. The company is backed by Craft Ventures.

providers.name: Minoan
providers.description: Minoan is a hospitality procurement and shoppable-stays platform. Short-term-rental hosts, property managers, hotels, and interior designers source furniture, decor, and home goods at insider/trade pricing through Minoan's purchasing platform, and earn revenue share when guests buy the items they experienced during a stay. Founded to turn every hosted space into a shoppable showroom, Minoan connects properties to hundreds of home-and-lifestyle brands and handles sourcing, checkout, and fulfillment. Backed by Accel. As of this profile Minoan exposes no public developer API; this record captures its public web, security, and llms.txt surface.

providers.name: Choco
providers.description: Choco is an AI-powered digital ordering platform that simplifies how restaurants order from their food suppliers and distributors. Serving tens of thousands of distributors and over one hundred thousand buyers across the US, UK, Europe, and the GCC, Choco lets restaurateurs place orders and chat with all their suppliers in one app while converting orders into a supplier's preferred format (email, WhatsApp, text, fax, or direct ERP integration). Choco connects to supplier ERP systems such as Entree, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics, Target Data System, NCR, Sage, and Odoo, and uses AI — including OrderAgent for multimodal order capture and VoiceAgent built on OpenAI's Realtime API — to turn emails, texts, images, and documents into structured, ERP-ready orders. Choco does not publish a public developer API; integration is delivered through managed ERP connections, and its public GitHub organization (chocoapp) hosts only internal data-engineering and infrastructure tooling rather than client SDKs or API specifications.

providers.name: Max Retail
providers.description: Max Retail is a Techstars-backed platform that helps brick-and-mortar boutiques and multi-location retailers turn unsold and aged inventory into cash. Retailers connect their point-of-sale or e-commerce system — Shopify, RICS, or Square — or upload a CSV, and Max Retail lists, markets, and sells the items to a network of shoppers across multiple channels, handles customer service, and pays out through Stripe when a prepaid shipping label is scanned. The retailer only ships; Max Retail charges a flat 15% fee plus shipping. Max Retail integrates inbound with third-party commerce platforms and payment processors but does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a webhook surface of its own.

providers.name: Xpedeon
providers.description: Xpedeon is a construction-specific ERP platform from Algorithms Software Pvt Ltd (30+ years in construction software), serving general contractors, specialist contractors, housebuilders and developers, engineer-to-order manufacturers, and off-site manufacturers across the UK, India, the GCC, and the US. The cloud platform covers construction finance and accounting, job costing and CVR, contract and subcontractor management, procurement, inventory and supply chain, plant and equipment, warehouse management, HR and payroll, CRM, and a mobile app for site teams, and is ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, 27701 and SOC 2 certified. Xpedeon publishes no public API, developer portal, or integration documentation, but does publish an llms.txt. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: CloudTrucks
providers.description: CloudTrucks (operated by Cloud Technologies, Inc.) is a San Francisco-based virtual trucking carrier and business-management platform for owner-operators and small trucking fleets. The platform aggregates freight loads from more than fifty brokers and shippers into a single app, and layers on load booking, dispatching, real-time tracking, instant pay on proof of delivery, invoicing, factoring, fuel discounts (FuelApp), insurance, and back-office financial tooling so independent drivers can run their business from a phone. CloudTrucks also operates Exchange for shippers and brokers plus a freight-agent program, and is backed by Craft Ventures, Kindred Ventures and Menlo Ventures. CloudTrucks does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal; this profile captures its public web, legal, support and mobile-app surface plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Food Market Hub
providers.description: Food Market Hub is a cloud-based procurement, inventory, and supply-chain management platform for food-and-beverage businesses, founded in Malaysia and headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Selangor. It automates back-end operations for restaurants, cafes, and central kitchens — connecting F&B outlets with their suppliers and central kitchens to handle purchase-order creation, smart ordering, inventory tracking, food-cost and wastage control, supplier management, and real-time reporting. The platform serves brands such as KFC, Pizza Hut, Salad Atelier, and Kenny Hills alongside thousands of independent restaurants across Southeast Asia (Malaysia, Indonesia, and China), and is delivered through web and iOS/Android mobile apps. Food Market Hub is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; integrations (including POS sales-data connections) are handled directly by the company.

providers.name: Mercanto
providers.description: Mercanto (mercanto.mx) is a Mexican B2B wholesale marketplace that supplies restaurants, cafeterias, and food-service businesses with ingredients, groceries, cleaning supplies, and packaging bought at wholesale from vetted suppliers, with negotiated pricing and next-day delivery. Buyers order across categories including produce, groceries and pantry, dairy and eggs, proteins and cold cuts, bakery and desserts, beverages, frozen foods, and non-food items, while Mercanto handles supplier selection, negotiation, and fulfillment. The company is backed by Bain Capital Ventures. Its customer-facing storefront runs on a private backend (api.mercanto.mx) that is not publicly documented for third-party developers, so there is no public API product, developer portal, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Noosh
providers.description: Noosh is a marketing execution and print/procurement management platform that gives enterprise marketing teams visibility and control over campaigns spanning direct mail, print, and point-of-sale (POS) materials. The software coordinates collaborative marketing workflows, agency and supplier performance tracking, vendor diversity management, and cost, quality, time, and sustainability data, and integrates with procurement and other enterprise systems. Noosh was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and profiled in the API Evangelist network. Noosh operates a customer-facing web application (Procurement Portal and Administration Portal) but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Panjiva
providers.description: Panjiva is a supply chain intelligence platform owned by S&P Global Market Intelligence that delivers data-driven insights for the global trade community. It combines global import/export shipment records with machine learning analytics to profile companies, map supply chains, benchmark competitors, surface sales leads, and assess counterparty and supply-chain risk. Panjiva covers roughly 9 million companies and more than 2 billion shipment records spanning an estimated 35% of global trade flows. Trade data is also delivered programmatically to CRM systems, quantitative models, and research workflows through S&P Global's XpressFeed data-feed service and is surfaced inside S&P Capital IQ Pro. Access is enterprise and subscription based; Panjiva does not publish a public self-serve developer API portal.

providers.name: Resourcify
providers.description: Resourcify (Resourcify GmbH) is a Hamburg, Germany based digital platform for waste management and circular-economy operations, describing itself as "the operating system for a circular future." Its cloud software helps enterprises digitize and optimize their waste streams end to end - automating waste and recycling operations, optimizing cost, CO2 and recycling rates, tracking compliance, and running take-back systems - across manufacturing, construction, retail, healthcare, and airports. The platform connects waste producers with a network of recyclers and haulers, captures waste data and documentation, and reports on sustainability and material recovery. Resourcify is backed by Speedinvest. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal; integrations are delivered as managed connections rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Souco
providers.description: Souco (株式会社souco / souco Co., Ltd.) operates a warehouse-sharing marketplace and logistics resource optimization platform in Japan, connecting cargo owners with available space across a nationwide network of 3,000+ warehouses spanning all 47 prefectures. Businesses can secure short- or long-term storage on demand for a wide range of cargo — food ingredients, apparel, machinery, and documents — under ambient, refrigerated, frozen, or temperature-controlled conditions, with pickup and delivery coordination handled by the platform. Alongside the sharing marketplace, souco offers a rental-warehouse search portal, transportation services, and the Optis engine for optimizing logistics networks, plus consulting and DX support for the logistics industry. The company is backed by 500 Global and Sumitomo Corporation's corporate venture arm. souco is a customer-facing logistics platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; its digital surface is a login-gated web application at app.souco.space.

providers.name: Trendsi
providers.description: Trendsi is a wholesale clothing supplier and dropshipping platform for online fashion retailers, boutiques, and social-commerce creators. Delivered primarily as a Shopify app and a TikTok Shop integration, Trendsi lets sellers source trendy apparel — dresses, tops, and activewear — and offer dropshipping, open-pack wholesale, private labeling, and made-to-order fulfillment with no upfront inventory. The platform handles sourcing, warehousing, packing, and shipping under the retailer's own brand, with competitive wholesale pricing and fast US shipping. Sellers manage their catalog, orders, and fulfillment from the Trendsi seller portal at app.trendsi.com. Trendsi does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration with a merchant's store is delivered through its Shopify and TikTok Shop apps.

providers.name: Approve.com
providers.description: Approve.com is a cloud-based procurement platform founded in 2019 in Israel that lets businesses stand up a proper purchase-order process quickly, streamlining purchase requisitions, multi-step approvals, real-time budgets, and vendor onboarding with real-time spend controls and insights. Tipalti acquired Approve.com in April 2021 and now operates it as Tipalti Procurement (Tipalti Approve). Its Procurement REST API is still served from the approve.com domain (production https://triggers.approve.com, sandbox https://triggers.sandbox.approve.com), authenticating with an x-api-key header and exchanging JSON with ISO 8601 dates; the purchase-orders API exposes GET and Update purchase-order operations so an external system can stay in sync with Tipalti.

providers.name: Pavilion
providers.description: Pavilion is a government purchasing platform that helps public-sector buyers find vendors, get quotes, and buy what they need without the guesswork. It connects procurement teams at 3,500+ SLED (state, local, and education) agencies with qualified vendors, surfaces the most direct compliant route to purchase based on each agency's rules and existing cooperative contracts, and lets vendors claim a free supplier profile to get discovered. The product is 100% free for public agencies. Pavilion is a SaaS marketplace backed by Forerunner Ventures.

providers.name: Rapyd
providers.description: Rapyd is a global Fintech-as-a-Service network offering collect, disburse, hold, and issue capabilities across 100+ countries with local payment methods, cards, and bank transfers.

providers.name: Diagon
providers.description: Diagon is a California-based industrial equipment sourcing company building Albus, an equipment intelligence platform for manufacturing buyers and sellers. Buyers search across millions of industrial equipment listings, compare models, specifications, pricing and availability, and connect directly with sellers; sellers publish AI-powered catalogs, reach qualified buyer demand, and see live equipment searches in real time. Diagon indexes manufacturing equipment products, suppliers and service providers, bringing hardware, services and financing into a consolidated procurement experience. Founded by a team out of Tesla, Bright Machines, Rivian and Snackpass, and backed by Anthemis under its data, tech and infrastructure thesis. Diagon publishes no public developer API today; its /api surface is an authenticated first-party application API (Clerk-based session auth) and is disallowed in robots.txt.

providers.name: Leta
providers.description: Leta is a pan-African logistics technology company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya, with operations across Kenya, Nigeria and South Africa. Leta builds an AI-driven delivery management platform that helps businesses move goods cheaper and faster while minimising climate impact: route optimization, automated dispatch and broadcast, live GPS track-and-trace, payment on delivery, fleet management, and delivery analytics. The platform is delivered as logistics SaaS plus on-demand and dedicated rider services, including an M-PESA business mini-app, and serves e-commerce, third-party logistics and courier, food and beverage, retail and consumer goods, and pharmacy and healthcare delivery operators. Leta is backed by Speedinvest.

providers.name: NuORDER
providers.description: NuORDER by Lightspeed is a global B2B commerce platform for wholesale buying and selling between brands and retailers. It combines a fully-branded wholesale eCommerce storefront with account-specific pricing and discounts, an Assortments planning tool for data-driven buying and reduced markdowns, and a Marketplace that connects buyers to 3,000+ brands across fashion, footwear, and apparel. NuORDER exposes a partner-gated REST API at api.nuorder.com for syncing products, orders, catalogs, and customer data with ERP, PIM, and other commerce systems. Acquired by Lightspeed in 2021, it is used by brands including Arc'teryx, Kendra Scott, TOMS, Barbour, and Canada Goose.

providers.name: VOO (now SideUp)
providers.description: VOO was an Egyptian logistics marketplace that rebranded as SideUp in December 2022, relocating its headquarters to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. SideUp is a fully integrated courier marketplace that lets e-commerce businesses ship locally and globally from one dashboard, connecting merchants with multiple courier services alongside payment gateways, shipping API integration, warehousing, and fulfillment, with plugins for Shopify, Salla, and OpenCart. Backed by 500 Global, Launch Africa VC, Riyadh Angels, and Alex Angels ($1.2M seed). No public developer portal or API documentation is published as of July 2026.

providers.name: Certa
providers.description: Certa (operated by Opinr, Inc. d/b/a Certa) is an AI-native third-party risk management (TPRM) and compliance platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle — onboarding, due diligence, contract management, continuous compliance monitoring, and offboarding — in a single no-code system. Founded by Jag Lamba and headquartered in Saratoga, CA, Certa serves Fortune 500 companies (Honeywell, Uber, Mars, Box, Quantcast) across 120+ countries and 17 languages. The platform covers all risk domains — operational and resilience, infosec and cyber, compliance and legal, financial and credit, reputational, geopolitical, and ESG and ethical risk — via its Studio no-code process designer, Certa Connect (130+ native integrations), and embedded AI agents. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools. External integration is available through an enterprise external API surfaced from the platform; no public OpenAPI or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Emirates SkyCargo
providers.description: Emirates SkyCargo is the air cargo division of Emirates Airline, headquartered at Dubai International Airport in the United Arab Emirates, moving general freight, pharmaceuticals, perishables, live animals, valuables, mail and courier traffic across a network of more than 140 destinations on six continents using both freighters and passenger-aircraft bellyhold capacity. In the shipment chain it is the airborne carrier leg sitting between the freight forwarder and the ground handler, and it books almost exclusively through intermediaries rather than shippers directly. Its API posture is advertised but not published: Emirates SkyCargo states on its own Digital Booking Channels page that it offers "a direct API connection to your in-house system" covering booking creation, amendments, cancellations and track and trace, yet there is no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or AsyncAPI document, no base URL and no self-serve signup anywhere on skycargo.com. Access is obtained only by emailing SkyCargoAPISupport@emirates.com to negotiate a host-to-host connection, by integrating through the CargoWise transport management system, by submitting Freight Forwarding Requests over EDI, or by booking through the WebCargo, CargoAi, Pelicargo and cargo.one marketplaces, which themselves require IATA/CASS accreditation. The one standard the organization documents on its own surface is IATA e-AWB: agents must sign the IATA Multilateral e-AWB Agreement before submitting FWB and FHL cargo messages over EDI messaging. This is an EDI-and-bilateral-integration carrier with a customer-contract portal veneer, not a public API provider.

providers.name: Kaman Corporation
providers.description: Kaman Corporation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Kaman Corporation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Lyric
providers.description: Lyric is an AI-powered supply chain software company, founded in 2022 and backed by Insight Partners. Its Lyric Studio platform lets enterprises model, plan, and optimize their supply chains across four composable layers — Data (enterprise-grade data management and integrations), Algorithms (advanced supply chain science), Workflows (flexible, composable processes), and Models & Apps (ready-to-use applications). The platform spans network modeling, transportation optimization, inventory management, forecasting, routing, and scheduling. Lyric does not publish a public developer API surface; its product documentation at docs.lyric.tech is gated behind a Lyric Studio login. It does operate a public SafeBase security and trust portal documenting SOC 2, SOC 3, ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR, CCPA, CPRA, and CSA STAR Level 1 posture plus a responsible disclosure program.

providers.name: Ontruck
providers.description: Ontruck is a Spanish road-freight technology platform that connects shippers (cargadores) with a network of professional carriers (transportistas) for full-truckload and less-than-truckload pallet, package, and parcel transport across Spain, France, and wider Europe. Shippers get instant AI-driven pricing, automated carrier assignment, real-time traceability, and digital documentation through service tiers (Economy, Flex, Express); carriers get access to freight loads with dynamic pricing and 24/7 support. Ontruck also packages its stack as "Ontruck AI Tech" — an AI pricing engine, AI routing engine, a predictive incident system, and a forecast/capacity planner — offered as transport-management software. The company operates a marketing and customer web surface plus an in-product shipper/carrier application; it publishes no public developer/API portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Porter Airlines
providers.description: Porter Airlines is a Canadian carrier headquartered in Toronto, operating as Porter Airlines (Canada) Limited and Porter Airlines Inc. under IATA designator PD, IATA ticketing plate 451, and ICAO code POE. It is the challenger to the Air Canada / WestJet duopoly in Canada, flying an Embraer E195-E2 and De Havilland Dash 8 fleet across domestic, transborder and sun destinations, and it joined IATA as a member in 2026 following IOSA certification. Porter sits in the distribution chain as a conventional GDS-intermediated carrier: agencies reach its inventory through the GDSs (Sabre is named explicitly in Porter's agency terms, and Travelport is the channel Duffel uses to resell Porter content) or through Porter's own ticketless Travel Agency Portal on flyporter.com. Porter's API posture is honestly stated as none-published. There is no developer portal, no public or partner API documentation, no OpenAPI, and no NDC endpoint of any kind. The developer, developers and apis subdomains do not resolve; api.flyporter.com resolves but does not answer on 80 or 443; docs.flyporter.com redirects to an internal Google Drive. Every well-known spec path returns 404 and the whole site sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge with ai-train=no content signals. Access is accreditation-gated: an agency must hold ARC accreditation or an IATA Passenger Sales Agency Agreement, register on flyporter.com, and accept Porter's Agency Terms and Conditions, which assert Porter ownership of all Porter Data, prohibit scraping and redistribution, and revoke all data rights the moment an appointment is suspended or terminated. There is no exit path beyond a written PIPEDA access request to Porter's Privacy Officer.

providers.name: Riff
providers.description: Riff is an Oslo, Norway based enterprise software company building AI agents for supply chain, procurement, planning, and logistics operations. Its agents automate repetitive back-office work such as chasing supplier order confirmations, updating order and delivery status, matching invoices, and monitoring deliveries, while keeping actions deterministic, auditable, and team-controlled rather than purely generative. Riff integrates non-disruptively with existing ERP systems including SAP, Oracle, Infor, and Microsoft, is EU-based with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 aligned and GDPR compliant data handling, and was founded by veterans of Cognite. The company raised a $16M Series A backed by Northzone and other investors. Riff has no public developer or API program at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: AfterShip
providers.description: AfterShip is an e-commerce shipment tracking and post-purchase platform. APIs cover trackings, couriers, notifications, returns, and email.

providers.name: Clutter
providers.description: Clutter is a full-service, on-demand storage and moving company (clutter.com) that picks up, professionally packs and photo-catalogs customers' belongings, stores them in secure 24/7-monitored warehouses, and redelivers individual items on demand. Founded in 2013 and once a SoftBank-backed unicorn, Clutter merged with MakeSpace and was acquired by Iron Mountain in 2023; it now operates as "Clutter by Iron Mountain" serving major US metros and Toronto. This is a consumer-facing services company with a customer account portal and booking flow but no public developer program or API; the record is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company/portfolio tracking.

providers.name: SmartHop
providers.description: SmartHop is a fleet and trip management platform for small trucking companies, owner-operators, and independent dispatchers. It aggregates real-time loads from multiple freight sources into a single load board and provides load booking, trip creation and management, dispatch management, payroll, profit optimization, market analysis, and performance reporting. SmartHop consumes third-party freight APIs from partners including DAT Freight & Analytics, C.H. Robinson, Loadsmart, Redwood Logistics, Newtrul, and Parade, but does not publish a public developer API of its own; its api.smarthop.co host backs the SmartHop web and mobile apps rather than a documented external API.

providers.name: Partsimony
providers.description: Partsimony is an intelligent supply chain platform that helps hardware companies turn engineering designs into manufactured products with less time, cost, and friction. Its software analyzes component designs to recommend manufacturing methods, materials, price estimates, and lead times, then matches each part to the optimal manufacturers inside and outside a company's network — batching components for volume leverage across processes like 3D printing, CNC machining, injection molding, castings, electronics, and assemblies. The platform also coordinates RFPs, proposals, orders, messaging, and payment terms between OEMs and their manufacturing partners. Partsimony operates a web application and product documentation but does not currently publish a public developer API. Founded in 2015 and based in Brooklyn, NY; backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Cogoport
providers.description: Cogoport is a global logistics and supply chain platform offering freight booking, customs, trade finance, and supply chain visibility for businesses across ocean, air, and inland transport. It provides ocean (FCL and LCL) and air freight booking with real-time rate discovery, customs clearance and compliance support, trade finance including invoice financing and pay-later solutions, end-to-end shipment tracking, and logistics tools such as an HS Code Finder, container trackers, and shipping cost calculators. Cogoport is backed by Accel and headquartered in India, serving importers and exporters worldwide.

providers.name: Regrello
providers.description: Regrello is an AI operating system for manufacturing and supply chain operations, giving teams that are stuck in email and stifled by decades-old ERPs an agentic AI platform to accelerate innovation and productivity. Its product, Agentforce Operations, orchestrates enterprise manufacturing and supply chain workflows with generative AI. Regrello was acquired by Salesforce and is backed by a16z and Bloomberg Beta. This profile currently exposes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network for its identity, security posture, and published compliance program.

providers.name: Replenysh
providers.description: Replenysh is an enterprise circularity platform that runs circular supply chains for brands and recovery facilities. It routes, recovers, verifies, and optimizes material recovery flows across a network of 5,000+ partners, giving enterprises a single control layer for reverse logistics with audit-ready chain-of-custody, pricing, settlement, and compliance documentation. Customers include PepsiCo, Disney, Marriott, and Live Nation. Backed by Kindred Ventures and M13. Surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched via the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Rex Airlines
providers.description: Rex Airlines (Regional Express, IATA ZL / ICAO RXA) is Australia's second-largest regional carrier, headquartered in Mascot, New South Wales, flying a Saab 340 fleet to roughly 45 regional destinations across every Australian state. Formed in 2002 from the merger of Hazelton and Kendell Airlines, Rex entered voluntary administration in July 2024 and was acquired by US holding company Air T in December 2025 with Australian federal government debt support. In the distribution chain Rex is the inventory owner, not an intermediary — it runs Sabre's SabreSonic passenger service suite (inventory, reservations, ticketing, ancillaries, check-in) per Sabre's February 2021 announcement, sells direct through its own ASP.NET booking engine at ibe2.rex.com.au, and reaches trade through a web-only Travel Agent portal gated on an IATA, DAPA or TIDS agency number. Its API posture is honest to state plainly: no developer portal, no public documentation, no OpenAPI, and no NDC claim anywhere on rex.com.au. The only published trace of a programmatic interface is a bare "Request API Access" checkbox on the agent registration form — accreditation required, contract unspecified, nothing documented, and no exit path beyond a privacy-law request to the Customer Contact Centre.

providers.name: Tillpoint
providers.description: Tillpoint is a modular, cloud-based EPOS (electronic point of sale) and business management platform for retail, hospitality, and services. A single subscription bundles 25+ modules - Point of Sale, Inventory, Customers/CRM, Staff, Accounting, Purchase Orders, Reporting, and more - across one terminal or thousands of locations. As of this review Tillpoint does not publish a documented public or partner developer API - there is no developer portal, no API reference, and no OpenAPI. Connectivity is delivered through pre-built integrations (QuickBooks Online, Xero, WooCommerce, PayPal, Worldpay, Mailchimp). The API surfaces catalogued here (Point of Sale, Inventory, Customers, Accounting) are logical capability areas of the platform and are honestly marked as endpointsModeled - no endpoints are fabricated. Direct/programmatic access requires contacting Tillpoint.

providers.name: Forward Air
providers.description: Forward Air is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Forward Air API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Heartland Express
providers.description: Heartland Express is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Heartland Express API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Knight-Swift Transportation
providers.description: Knight-Swift Transportation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Knight-Swift Transportation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Nabu
providers.description: Nabu is an AI-powered customs clearance platform that automates international trade compliance end to end. It collects shipment data from emails, PDFs, Excel files, databases, and TMS records via API, EDI, SFTP, or email, prepares complete compliant customs files, and generates pre-filled import/export declarations ready for submission in standard customs software. Nabu targets customs brokers and declaration teams, offering autonomous processing, workload flexibility to absorb staffing gaps, and full auditability across multiple regions and local regulatory regimes. Backed by Techstars. No public developer API, documentation, or SDKs are published at this time.

providers.name: Nium
providers.description: Nium is a global payments infrastructure platform for cross-border payouts, collections, FX, and card issuing. Serves financial institutions, fintechs, and corporates with a single API.

providers.name: Omnitracs
providers.description: Omnitracs is a commercial fleet management, telematics, and transportation-management provider, now part of Solera Inc. (acquired 2021, operating under Solera Fleet Solutions). Its Omnitracs One platform and the Omnitracs Roadnet routing platform serve roughly 15,000 fleet customers with ELD / Hours-of-Service compliance, telematics and GPS positioning, driver workflow and messaging, routing and dispatch, and video safety. Omnitracs exposes real integration APIs and web services (Roadnet Web Services, the Services Portal Entity Management web services, and the SOAP/XML Event Subscription Service that streams positions, messages, HOS, and critical events), but access is partner- and customer-account gated - there is no open, self-service public developer portal. API credentials (a username/password with API access) and the integration developer wiki are provisioned to contracted customers and integration partners. Endpoints documented here for gated surfaces are honestly modeled from public integration notes, not from an open reference.

providers.name: AlphaLoops FMCSA Carrier Data API
providers.description: The carrier data layer for freight — FMCSA motor-carrier intelligence covering carrier profiles, authority & insurance history, VIN-level fleet data, roadside inspections, crashes, corporate connections, decision-maker contacts, and risk/watchlist monitoring. Exposes a REST API, a live OpenAPI 3.1 contract, a hosted MCP server with 30+ tools, and published Python/TypeScript SDKs plus a CLI.

providers.name: Olive Technologies
providers.description: Olive is an AI-native vendor evaluation and technology procurement platform that runs the full RFP lifecycle in a single workspace — from requirements management and stakeholder collaboration through AI-powered comparative vendor scoring and final selection. It maintains vendor intelligence across more than 12,000 vendors and 380+ categories, and is built for IT leaders, procurement teams, and consultancies who need unbiased, structured software sourcing. Olive is a Techstars-backed company; by design it takes no fees from vendors, funding the platform through buyer subscriptions instead. Olive has no public developer API surface — no documentation, SDKs, or API reference are published at this time; this profile captures the company's public web and security posture.

providers.name: On the Beach
providers.description: On the Beach Group plc (LSE: OTB) is a Manchester-headquartered online travel agent and the United Kingdom's largest online short-haul beach package holiday specialist, founded in 2004 by Simon Cooper and registered at Aeroworks, 5 Adair Street, Manchester M1 2NQ. It sits on the demand side of the travel distribution chain: an asset-light dynamic packager that buys real-time seats from 42 airlines and hotel inventory from bedbanks and direct hotel contracts, combines them into ATOL-protected packages, and sells them direct to UK and Republic of Ireland consumers through onthebeach.co.uk, sunshine.co.uk and its mobile app. FY25 total transaction value was GBP 1.25bn across 1.7 million customers. It is a consumer of other operators' distribution APIs rather than a publisher of its own - it was the first UK OTA to take a direct NDC connection to Emirates' Online B2B API in 2019 and signed a direct Ryanair "Approved OTA" partnership in 2024 - and it explicitly bypasses the GDS layer entirely. Its API posture as a producer is almost non-existent. The FY25 results describe an "API-first microservices architecture" and a proprietary Hotel Discovery Cache managing more than 5 billion hotel prices, but none of that surface is published: there is no developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, no partner or trade API, and no self-serve access of any kind. Its only remaining B2B channel, Classic Collection, was put into orderly wind-down on 23 September 2025. The single exception, and the first externally addressable machine surface the company has ever shipped, is a ChatGPT App launched on 1 April 2026 - claimed as the first by a UK OTA - which serves live, bookable package combinations to ChatGPT users over MCP. That surface is distribution-gated rather than developer-facing: no endpoint, tool list, schema, auth flow or terms are documented, and a deliberate mcp.onthebeach.co.uk host exists but is Cloudflare WAF-blocked to every probe.

providers.name: Sybilion
providers.description: Sybilion is a decision layer for industrial companies, providing economic and causal forecasting that connects external market dynamics to internal exposure for procurement, trading and risk teams. It exposes forecasts, their drivers, and alerts via a REST API and a hosted MCP server.

providers.name: Terminal Logistics
providers.description: Terminal Industries (Terminal Logistics) is the company behind the Terminal Yard Operating System (YOS), an AI-native, fully-integrated platform for yard operations across logistics and supply chain. It unifies gate management, carrier risk assessment and driver ID, dispatch and spotter orchestration, yard visibility, load verification, carrier appointments, and end-to-end yard security from the gate to the dock, using computer vision and agentic AI. It serves third-party logistics, retail and grocery, consumer packaged goods, refrigerated warehousing, contract carriers, manufacturing facilities, and drop lots. Backed by 8vc. No public developer API is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web, security, and status surface.

providers.name: trawa
providers.description: trawa (operated by Future Energy Services GmbH) is a Berlin-based energy management company that helps mid-sized businesses procure and manage electricity. It pairs AI-optimized green-electricity sourcing on the wholesale market with cloud energy-management software that gives customers real-time visibility into consumption, costs, and CO2 emissions, alongside battery storage and smart control of energy-consuming assets such as CHP plants and charging stations. Founded in 2022, trawa is backed by Balderton Capital and Speedinvest. The platform is delivered through a customer web portal and a trust center; no public developer API was found as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Arvist
providers.description: Arvist AI is a Chicago-based computer-vision platform for warehouse and supply-chain operations that turns existing cameras, scanners, and WMS/ERP data into automated quality control, safety and compliance monitoring, load verification, inbound shipment inspection, and freight-claims management. The system deploys on-premise edge servers, integrates with 80+ leading WMS and ERP platforms without new hardware, and detects damage, defects, unsafe behavior, and outbound shipping errors in real time. Backed by Techstars, Arvist is ISO 27001 certified and SOC 2 Type I compliant. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched from Arvist's public web surface; the company currently publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI.

providers.name: Metalshub
providers.description: Metalshub (Metals Hub GmbH) is a Berlin-based digital platform for the metals, mining, and recycling industries, enabling over 2,800 industry participants to buy, sell, and trade raw materials online. Its procurement, sales, and tolling solutions help companies source ferroalloys, minor metals, noble alloys, and recycled materials, discover new suppliers and customers, run digital tenders and auctions, and manage the full transaction lifecycle from negotiation to contract. Backed by Point Nine and other investors, Metalshub operates a login-gated trading application at trade.metals-hub.com. No public API or developer program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Office Luv
providers.description: OfficeLuv is office management and purchasing software that centralizes all of a workplace's ordering into a single platform. It aggregates dozens of vendors and thousands of products (supplies, snacks, cleaning supplies, groceries, and more) into one unified marketplace with consolidated invoicing, spend analytics and reporting, multi-user approval workflows, employee stipends for remote and in-office staff, and optional on-site service for program design, pricing negotiation, and restocking. Customers include Wayfair, Braze, Glassdoor, Hulu, and Upwork. Office Luv was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. The product is delivered as a private SaaS web application (app.officeluv.com); no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published at this time.

providers.name: SVT Robotics
providers.description: SVT Robotics builds the SOFTBOT Platform, a software integration and orchestration foundation for warehouse automation and the supply chain. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Norfolk, Virginia, the company lets enterprises connect industrial systems, robotics, AMRs, and warehouse management software through standardized, prebuilt SOFTBOT Connectors — reducing integration complexity and enabling real-time visibility, faster automation deployments, and a resilient data backbone for automation and AI. Customers include DHL Supply Chain, Barrett Distribution Centers, and the Hagen Group. The provider operates a developer documentation hub for the SOFTBOT integration API (docs.svtrobotics.com, currently password-protected) and a public status page; no public OpenAPI, SDK, or open API surface was discoverable at enrichment time.

providers.name: Comstruct
providers.description: Comstruct is a Munich-based construction technology company that provides AI-powered agents to automate the procurement of construction materials. Its platform runs the full procurement workflow from the bill of materials (Leistungsverzeichnis) through supplier inquiry, offer comparison, contract negotiation, digital delivery notes, AI-based invoice verification, and sustainability reporting. Customers include HOCHTIEF, Implenia, Marti, and Leonhard Weiss. Comstruct is backed by GV (Google Ventures). As of enrichment the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network from its public web presence.

providers.name: Faire
providers.description: Faire is a wholesale marketplace connecting independent retailers with brands. The Faire External API v2 supports both sides of the marketplace: brand-side endpoints for products, orders, inventory, and shipments, and retailer-side endpoints for browsing and ordering.

providers.name: Walter
providers.description: Walter is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building an AI employee for the manufacturing back office. Founded in 2026 by Nikolas Keller (CEO) and Lukas Postulka (CTO), Walter logs into the enterprise systems a company already runs on — SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Teams, Outlook and Gmail — the way a new hire would, and takes over manual paperwork: reading sales orders and purchase orders from emails and PDFs, capturing and validating the data, cross-checking it against the ERP, ordering from suppliers and catching pricing errors before they ship. It uses a purpose-built document-understanding model (rather than legacy template OCR) that supports 270+ languages and reaches 90%+ accuracy after minimal training, cutting an order that used to take 15 minutes down to about one. Walter requires no integration project and no rip-and-replace, operating the same screens the team already uses. It is an early-stage company with no public API, developer program, SDKs or documentation; this profile captures its public identity and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Aily Labs
providers.description: Aily Labs is a Munich-based enterprise AI company that builds an AI Decision Intelligence Suite — a platform that connects siloed internal and external data to deliver real-time, explainable predictions and recommendations across Finance, R&D, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Go-To-Market, Procurement, and People functions. The suite ships with 300+ validated predictive models and an iOS app, and is deployed across Healthcare & Life Sciences, Consumer Goods, Luxury & Fashion, Media & Tech, Retail, and Services (clients include Sanofi). Aily Labs is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. It exposes no public developer API; this profile captures the company's corporate, security, and compliance surface.

providers.name: EAS Innovations Inc
providers.description: EAS Innovations Inc operates ELEV8, an end-to-end, cloud-based dealer management system (DMS) built for independent auto dealers and automotive finance companies. The platform unifies real-time accounting, inventory management, CRM and desking, loan servicing, payments and collections into a single fully-integrated system. It offers per-seat pricing, user-based access rights, user-level audit logs, whitelisted IP addresses, multi-rooftop access and department-level restrictions, and is delivered as a SaaS web application at app.elev8dms.com. EAS Innovations is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Flecto
providers.description: Flecto is a SaaS platform for rental businesses, providing tools to manage bookings, inventory, payments, and customer verification across both online and in-store channels. Backed by Techstars, the company offers "The Flecto Link" for flexible checkout, ID and face-scan verification, item protection and insurance, a hosted online store builder, and the Flecto Market marketplace. It supports payment methods including MB Way, PayPal, Mastercard, and Apple Pay. Flecto does not currently publish a public API or developer platform; this profile tracks its public web and business surface.

providers.name: FreightRoll
providers.description: FreightRoll is a logistics technology company whose flagship product, YardOS, is a customizable Yard Operating / Management System (YMS) that turns shipping and receiving yards into driver-friendly, self-service hubs. YardOS reduces truck-driver wait times, improves yard throughput, and streamlines gate and dock operations, with the company citing up to a 50% reduction in truck turnaround time, 95%+ fewer human-to-driver interactions, and $100K+ annual savings per facility across a network of 150,000+ registered drivers. FreightRoll integrates with existing systems across API, EDI, and SFTP mechanisms and deploys remotely in under an hour. The company is backed by 500 Global. FreightRoll does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition; its public website is Wix-hosted and exposes a Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic AI access to public site content.

providers.name: Greenwork
providers.description: Greenwork builds software for the HVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning) industry and is backed by GV (Google Ventures). Its flagship product, Onsite Pro, is a digital pricebook and proposal platform for HVAC distributors and their dealers: it replaces Excel and PDF catalogs with searchable product data, automated AHRI equipment matchups, incentive and rebate application, and one-click proposal generation, while giving distributors visibility into dealer catalog performance, win rates, and share of wallet. Greenwork does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures the company identity and its public web and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: HEDNA
providers.description: HEDNA (Hotel Electronic Distribution Network Association) is a not-for-profit trade association founded in 1991 and headquartered in Forest Hill, Maryland, United States, that convenes the hotel distribution industry — hotel chains, GDS operators, OTAs, switches, channel managers, payment providers and connectivity vendors — around shared best practice for hospitality electronic distribution. It sits alongside rather than inside the distribution chain: it moves no inventory and processes no bookings, but its Disciplines (Connectivity, Content Distribution, Payments, Data & Analytics, Revenue Optimization) produce recommendation documents, and it co-authored the Open Payments Alliance Standards Specification with HTNG and OpenTravel. HEDNA publishes no developer portal, no API, and no machine-readable specification on hedna.org; every probe of developer./developers./docs./api. subdomains and of /developers, /api, /docs, /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs and /.well-known/ failed (DNS failure or HTTP 404). Its publications library, research reports and HEDNA U courseware are gated behind paid membership at members.hedna.org (HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge unauthenticated) and pathlms.com/hedna. Honest posture: member-gated documents, no public API, no exit path published.

providers.name: Icertis
providers.description: Icertis is an AI-native contract intelligence company that turns enterprise contracts into structured, actionable data and measurable business outcomes. Its Contract Intelligence (ICI) platform manages agreements across their full lifecycle — authoring, negotiation, execution, obligation management, and ongoing analytics — spanning sell-side, buy-side, and corporate contracts. The platform pairs a configurable contract data model with AI capabilities (the "Vera" AI assistant and agent-powered drafting, redlining, and negotiation) trained on millions of contracts. Icertis serves large enterprises across manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, technology, financial services, and the public sector, and integrates with ERP, CRM, CPQ, and procurement systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, and Coupa. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and enriched from Icertis' public web presence.

providers.name: Kyrok
providers.description: Kyrok GmbH is a Berlin-based software company building an AI operating system for mid-sized pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers in Europe. The platform layers over a company's existing ERP (SAP S/4HANA, SAP R/3, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Infor, Applus) and connects the systems supply chain teams currently hold together by hand into intelligent operations across customer service, production planning, material planning and procurement. Kyrok positions itself on an "AI assists, people decide" model, running on European infrastructure in Frankfurt am Main, GDPR-compliant, with ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certifications in progress. The company announced a EUR 3.1M round in June 2026 and names AnalytiChem and Konapharma as customers. Kyrok connects to ERP systems via API but publishes no public developer API, API reference, or SDKs as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Nowports
providers.description: Nowports is a digital freight forwarder for Latin America, offering technology-enabled international logistics across ocean, air, and ground freight. Its Centraliza platform centralizes shipment tracking, document management, and alerts, while adjacent services cover cargo insurance and GPS tracking (Protege) and inventory financing and factoring (Financia). Backed by Partech and Y Combinator, Nowports serves importers and exporters on major trade routes through its authenticated web app at app.nowports.com. As of this profile Nowports exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; access is via its authenticated web platform.

providers.name: Silq
providers.description: Silq (OneSilq) is a digital freight forwarder delivering fast, transparent global shipping and supply-chain services. Offerings span ocean freight (full container load, less-than-container load and shared container load), air freight, buyer's consolidation, cargo value protection, customs brokerage and trucking/drayage, plus quality-control inspections across China, India, Vietnam, Indonesia and Bangladesh. The platform layers real-time shipment visibility, live ocean-carrier freight rates, expert trade advisory and built-in risk protection for importers and small shippers.

providers.name: CMA CGM
providers.description: CMA CGM is a Marseille-headquartered French container shipping, logistics, and port operator and the third-largest ocean carrier in the world. Founded in 1978 by Jacques Saadé and led today by Chairman & CEO Rodolphe Saadé, the CMA CGM Group operates a fleet of 593 vessels with 4.5 million TEU of capacity calling 420 ports across 160 countries on 257 maritime services. The group includes maritime brands ANL, APL, CNC Line, Containerships, Comanav, and Mercosul Line; terminal operator CMA Terminals and Terminal Link; the CEVA Logistics contract logistics and freight forwarding business (acquired 2019); CMA CGM Air Cargo; Brittany Ferries and La Méridionale passenger ferries; and the CMA Média portfolio (La Provence, La Tribune, BFM-RMC, Brut). Through api-portal.cma-cgm.com the group exposes a DCSA-aligned REST API surface — Track and Trace v1 (DCSA v2.2.0), Schedules, Booking Request, Quotation, and Invoice — plus a parallel EDI catalog (EDIFACT IFTSAI, IFTMBF, IFTSTA, INVOIC) and group-level digital initiatives including ZEBOX (startup accelerator), Traxens-based IoT smart containers, and a strategic AI partnership with Mistral.

providers.name: Dollar Tree
providers.description: Dollar Tree is a leading operator of discount variety stores in North America, operating more than 16,000 stores under the Dollar Tree and Family Dollar banners. Vendor and supplier integration is primarily handled through EDI, SAP, and ERP systems via the Dollar Tree Vendor Portal. No public REST API is currently available.

providers.name: IgniteTech
providers.description: IgniteTech is a global, AI-first enterprise software company (headquartered in Austin, Texas, and operating remote-first across 30+ countries) that acquires, revitalizes, and supports mission-critical enterprise software and embeds AI-powered capabilities across its portfolio — an operating model the company brands "AI-DNA." Its Native AI products include Eloquens AI (automated, context-aware email response), MyPersonas (AI digital clones of key employees that answer repetitive questions via a video chat-style interface), and Adminio AI (meeting scheduling through intelligent email orchestration). The IgniteTech Unlimited software library spans acquired enterprise brands such as GFI Software, Khoros (Communities and Care), Jive, DNN, Gensym, Computron, GRID (supply chain, via the Suuchi acquisition), Knova, AnswerHub, ACORN, TradeBeam, and SalesBuilder. Led by CEO Eric Vaughan, the company positions itself as an AI enterprise software company rather than only a software holding company.

providers.name: InventoryQuant
providers.description: InventoryQuant automates inventory and contents documentation for the insurance claims industry. Public adjusters, restoration firms, and insurance claim handlers record video or audio walkthroughs of a loss, and the platform transcribes each spoken line item, detects and describes the contents, matches replacement pricing from major retailers, and generates a submission-ready report in XactContents or PDF format. It supports smart glasses, photos, multiple speakers, self-corrections, background noise, and 100+ languages, turning days of manual contents-claim work into minutes. Founded in the Y Combinator Winter 2026 batch by Sander Schulhoff.

providers.name: Alcove
providers.description: Alcove is an AI-powered procurement and project management platform built for interior designers, contractors, event planners, and purchasing agents. It consolidates product details, quotes, financials, and order tracking into a single hub, automatically tracking orders across vendors and projects, managing tasks and timelines, calculating profitability and markups, and offering a purchasing service with Designer Net discounts. An AI assistant surfaces financial insights, suggests markups, reviews approvals, and powers filtering. Alcove is a Menlo Ventures portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it publishes a marketing site and web application but no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Diagon Technologies
providers.description: Diagon Technologies operates Albus, an industrial equipment intelligence and procurement platform for North American manufacturing. Albus aggregates millions of industrial equipment listings so buyers can search by make, model, or specification, compare equipment specs, pricing, and availability side by side, and connect directly with sellers to request quotes. Sellers publish AI-powered catalogs, reach qualified buyer demand, and see live equipment searches in real time across categories such as subtractive manufacturing, forming, joining, surface treatment, and polymer processing, and OEMs including DMG Mori, Trumpf, Okuma, FANUC, and Mazak. Diagon is a Techstars portfolio company; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Freterium
providers.description: Freterium is a cloud-native AI Transport Management System (TMS) and unified logistics operating system that connects shippers, carriers, and fleets on a single intelligent layer. It spans first-mile, middle-mile, and last-mile operations across eight integrated modules — order management, AI-powered route planning, collaborative shipper and carrier portals, real-time GPS tracking with predictive ETAs, fleet management, freight billing and costing, intelligent document control, and analytics and reporting — and exposes a documented REST API for ERP/WMS integration alongside 50+ off-the-shelf telematics and hardware integrations. Surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Partech portfolio company.

providers.name: Spoiler Alert
providers.description: Spoiler Alert is a Boston-based software company (a Techstars portfolio company) that helps consumer packaged goods (CPG) manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers manage and sell excess, short-dated, and obsolete inventory. Its purpose-built platform digitizes discounting and liquidation processes, matching surplus inventory with the right buyers at the right price through a secondary marketplace, with automated listing generation, dynamic pricing optimization, freight cost management, and performance analytics to recover margin and reduce food and product waste. The platform is delivered as a closed SaaS application (app.spoileralert.com); no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Tealet
providers.description: Tealet is a wholesale tea marketplace that connects independent tea growers and family farms directly with retailers and businesses. Buyers browse, trace, and order specialty teas sourced from family farms and cooperatives across 8 countries and 15 growing regions, with grower profiles, farm videos, subscription ordering, and a wholesale request flow that emphasize transparency and direct trade from source to cup. Tealet originated in Hawaii and is backed by 500 Startups and Blue Startups. The company operates a consumer/B2B web storefront with account sign-up, newsletter, and blog; it does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or an MCP server.

providers.name: ACV Auctions
providers.description: ACV Auctions is a digital wholesale marketplace for the automotive industry, operating the leading online platform for dealer-to-dealer used-vehicle auctions across the United States. Franchise and independent dealers source and sell inventory through daily online auctions backed by third-party vehicle inspections, detailed condition reports, and the company's data and analytics products. ACV also offers complementary services including vehicle transportation, dealer floor-plan financing through ACV Capital, and inventory-management and pricing tools. The company is publicly traded and headquartered in Buffalo, New York. It does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Deposco
providers.description: Deposco is a cloud supply chain execution platform combining order management (OMS) and warehouse management (WMS) for retailers, brands, 3PLs, and DTC ecommerce sellers. Its Bright Suite gives real-time visibility into inventory, orders, and shipments across the fulfillment lifecycle - receiving, putaway, picking, packing, and shipping. Deposco integrates through a REST API exposed on its Developer Portal (developer.deposco.com) using resource paths under /integration/{code}/, secured with OAuth 2.0 / per-merchant API credentials and scoped by tenant code and business unit. API access is provisioned per customer through a Deposco account manager rather than through open self-service signup, and Deposco also ships 150+ pre-built connectors and EDI integrations.

providers.name: Grove Health
providers.description: Grove Health (Grove Medical Inc.) is a North American B2B healthcare supplies distributor operating an online catalog covering medical equipment and consumables, including nursing supplies, diagnostics, wound care, incontinence products, examination gloves, respiratory equipment, and related healthcare items. The company serves healthcare facilities and providers through a self-service e-commerce storefront. It has been backed by General Catalyst since 2021. No public API, developer program, or machine-readable interface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and its public web surface.

providers.name: Produce Pay
providers.description: ProducePay is an agtech fintech platform for the global fresh-produce supply chain, giving growers, distributors, and buyers a combination of trade financing and operational tooling. Its offerings include Pre-Season Financing (working capital ahead of the growing season), Quick-Pay (converting produce shipments into immediate cash during peak season), Visibility (real-time shipment tracking, quality control, and data-driven insights), Sourcing (connecting buyers and sellers for long-term partnerships), and Predictable Commerce programs that bundle capital, visibility, and partnerships for year-round supply stability. The company operates a marketplace for its members but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: EXIGER
providers.description: Exiger is an AI-native supply chain, third-party, and software supply chain risk and compliance company. Its 1Exiger platform unifies supplier, product, part, component, and risk data into a single system to help organizations map and orchestrate compliant, resilient physical and software supply chains. Product areas span supply chain visibility and optimization, trade and third-party risk and compliance, due diligence intelligence (DDIQ), and software supply chain security (SBOM analysis, from its Ion Channel acquisition). Exiger serves government and commercial customers and is FedRAMP authorized. This profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and enriched from Exiger's public corporate, trust, and legal surfaces; Exiger does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or client SDKs.

providers.name: Forterro
providers.description: Forterro is a pan-European industrial software company, founded in 2012 and headquartered in London, that provides enterprise resource planning (ERP) and specialised business software to the industrial mid-market. Built through a series of acquisitions, Forterro operates a portfolio of regional and vertical ERP brands - including Abas, Jeeves, Garp, Proconcept, Sylob, Silog, Myfactory, Orderwise, Clipper, 123Insight, BPSC, Helios, Proffix, Prodaso and its cloud-native Fortee product - alongside best-in-class point solutions such as warehouse management (WMS), point of sale (POS), material requirements planning (MRP) and business intelligence. The company serves more than 13,000 industrial businesses across manufacturing, warehousing, wholesale and retail from 40+ offices worldwide.

providers.name: GoodShip
providers.description: GoodShip is a freight orchestration and procurement platform for shippers, brokers, and asset-based carriers. It unifies TMS tender, contract-award, and location data, enriches it with real-time market rates, and layers AI-assisted bid analysis (via its Laney AI transportation analyst), lane- and carrier-level performance analytics, carrier scorecards, and in-app collaboration on top. Teams run mini-bids and full-network RFPs, benchmark spend against the market, and take corrective action without dedicated developer resources. Plug-and-play with major transportation management systems; backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and serving US and Canadian operations.

providers.name: Reframe
providers.description: Reframe (usereframe.ai) is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator Winter 2026 company, founded in 2025 by Bryan Zin (previously a Product Design Engineer on the iPhone team at Apple) and Eric Wiener, building an AI-native hardware procurement platform. Reframe automates the manual procurement process in hardware supply chains: instead of emails and spreadsheets, AI agents handle purchase orders, supplier follow-ups, and part tracking for both COTS and custom-manufactured components, with Slack and Gmail integrations for team workflows. This API Evangelist profile tracks Reframe as a company in the network; the company does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Storyboard
providers.description: Storyboard is a fleet-operations AI platform that gives trucking and logistics companies voice-first, hands-free AI workers for their drivers. The system automates dispatch updates, driver coaching, safety alerts, and compliance monitoring (including hours-of-service and idling) so back-office teams field fewer phone calls and drivers stay hands-free on the road. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Santa Monica, California, Storyboard began as an enterprise podcast and internal-audio communication platform (a $4.5M seed round led by CRV in 2020) before pivoting to AI-powered fleet operations. It is distributed through in-cab telematics marketplaces such as Platform Science and ISAAC Instruments. Storyboard exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; access is via its web and mobile apps at app.storyboard.com. This profile was surfaced as a CRV portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Sunyur
providers.description: Sunyur (商越科技 / Beijing Sunyur Network Technology Co., Ltd, 北京商越网络科技有限公司) is a Chinese enterprise procurement digitalization company providing AI-driven procurement solutions for large and medium enterprises. Its products include an intelligent procurement middle-platform (采购中台), an SRM supplier relationship management system, an e-procurement SaaS platform, and a procurement mall (采购商城), helping each customer build a dedicated online, digital, and intelligent enterprise procurement platform to raise efficiency and lower cost. Sunyur operates an open integration platform ("聚贤阁", open.sunyur.com) that connects enterprises to 30+ mainstream e-commerce platforms and 10+ third-party applications through a single accessToken-authenticated API surface. Sunyur is backed by Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Trackonomy
providers.description: Trackonomy is a supply chain visibility company that digitizes real-world operations with barely-there smart label sensors. Its SmartTape and THL Tape products provide item-level tracking, monitoring location, temperature, humidity, and light in real time, while its platform connects, automates, controls, and remediates operations processes at global scale for logistics, industrial, utilities, healthcare, government, and airline customers. Trackonomy is backed by 8VC. It advertises a customizable RESTful API and webhook-based real-time data exchange for platform customers, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: WestRock
providers.description: WestRock (now Smurfit Westrock following its 2024 merger with Smurfit Kappa) is one of the world's largest paper and packaging companies. The company provides differentiated paper and packaging solutions including corrugated containers, consumer packaging, displays, and specialty packaging. WestRock serves consumer and industrial markets with an integrated supply chain connecting mills, converting operations, and customers globally.

providers.name: Backlotcars
providers.description: BacklotCars, Inc. is a dealer-to-dealer wholesale used-vehicle marketplace, founded in Kansas City and acquired by KAR Global (now OPENLANE, Inc.), whose technology was consolidated into the OPENLANE US marketplace. It connects thousands of franchise and independent dealers through a 24/7 bid-ask marketplace, "Buy It Now" listings, and timed auctions scheduled throughout each week, backed by native mobile apps, in-lane vehicle inspections with AI-analyzed engine recordings, transportation, and floor-plan financing. Commercial sellers and dealer groups can push inventory straight from their own systems into OPENLANE Sell via OPENLANE Connect, a lightweight dealer integration API with a dedicated test environment. This profile began as a 500 Global portfolio lead surfaced into the API Evangelist network and was enriched from OPENLANE's public marketing and product surface; the platform publishes no public OpenAPI or open developer portal.

providers.name: Djust
providers.description: DJUST is a French all-in-one, modular B2B commerce platform that helps distributors, wholesalers, manufacturers and retailers launch and automate their B2B eCommerce and eProcurement operations. The platform covers automated order management (24/7 online ordering), AI-assisted quoting with automatic pricing and discounts, integrated online payments with deadline tracking, a conversational AI sales assistant, real-time sales analytics, and prebuilt ERP/CRM integrations. Customers include Eiffage, Auchan Retail and Lesaffre; DJUST reports EUR 1.5B GMV and 2M orders processed in 2025. Backed by Speedinvest.

providers.name: Saia Inc
providers.description: Saia Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Saia Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Branddu
providers.description: Branddu (Branddu Colombia / Branddu AI) is a B2B MerchTech platform that digitizes corporate merchandising and promotional-product procurement across Latin America. Operating in Colombia and Mexico, it centralizes the full purchasing workflow - product discovery, inventory, quotations, customization, online design, and checkout - through a single online catalog of more than 15,000 fully customizable products across 46+ categories. Branddu AI (formed via a merger with Reno) combines AI, proprietary software, and a regional supplier network to simplify how companies source branded merchandise. The public storefront runs on Shopify. The company is backed by a US$300K pre-seed from 500 Global, bringing total capital raised to roughly US$800K.

providers.name: Partender
providers.description: Partender is a bar and beverage inventory management platform that lets hospitality operators complete a full physical liquor, wine, beer, and keg inventory in roughly fifteen minutes by tap-and-swipe estimating how full each bottle is, at up to 99.2% accuracy. The subscription SaaS spans iOS, Android, and web apps and adds online ordering, purchase orders auto-sorted by distributor, pour-cost and variance reporting, and lightweight accounting so venues can cut time, labor, and inventory loss. Founded in 2012 and backed by 500 Global, Partender serves bars, restaurants, hotels, and stadiums. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Partender exposes a consumer mobile/web product rather than a publicly documented developer API.

providers.name: Portex
providers.description: Portex is a freight procurement and management platform that replaces the emails, spreadsheets, and PDFs of traditional freight quoting with a single collaborative workspace.
