The holding company positions itself as the "Leader in Aviation Outsourcing" and runs three operating businesses: Atlas Air (ACMI, CMI, charter, and military/government cargo and passenger operations on Boeing 747-400F, 747-8F, 777F, 767, and 737-800BCF freighters), Polar Air Cargo (scheduled airport-to-airport cargo network, historically a joint venture with DHL), and Titan Aviation Leasing (commercial aircraft acquisition, leasing, and sale-leaseback services). Atlas is the largest operator of the Boeing 747 freighter, the Dreamlifter operator for Boeing, and one of the principal lift providers for Amazon Air's middle-mile network. In August 2022 a consortium led by Apollo Global Management with J.F. Lehman & Company and Hill City Capital agreed to take the company private in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately US$5.2 billion; the deal closed in March 2023, delisting the company (formerly Nasdaq: AAWW). As a freight carrier the group does not publish a public developer portal or open APIs — integrations with shippers, forwarders, and customers are delivered through private B2B channels (EDI, Cargo-IMP/XML messaging, airwaybill tracking on polaraircargo.com, and account-managed connectivity). A "Track Shipment" tool and a Special Loads request form (specialloads.atlasair.com) are the principal self-service surfaces; an internal-facing GitHub organization (Atlas-Air-Data-Platform) exists but publishes no public repos.

providers.name: Chord
providers.description: Chord is a New York / Santa Barbara-based commerce data and AI platform founded in 2021 by Bryan Mahoney (CEO) and Henry Davis (President & Chairman), both former Glossier executives. Chord began as a headless commerce backbone built on top of Solidus — the open-source Spree Commerce fork written in Ruby on Rails — and has since evolved into an AI-native commerce data platform with three layers: a Data Foundation that unifies sources such as Shopify, ad platforms, and CDPs; a Context Stack that grounds AI in store-specific business context; and a set of Agents that take action across the commerce stack. Its current product surface includes Chord OMS (a Solidus-based order management system covering orders, products, promotions, subscriptions, affiliates, gift cards, returns, shipping, tax, and digital products documented at chord.stoplight.io), Chord CDP (customer data platform with identity resolution, RFM scoring, customer lifetime revenue, and destination activations), Chord Event Tracking (client- and server-side eventing with Shopify Web Pixel integration and consent management via OneTrust and Shopify Customer Privacy API), Chord Data Platform (analytics, predictive modeling, attribution, recommendations, Fivetran ingestion, GA4 compatibility), and Chord AI / Copilot Chat, powered by Anthropic Claude (Opus 4.5 for SQL generation, Haiku 4.5 for response generation and classification) with charts, monitors, context modeling, and natural-language data querying. Chord's GitHub org (github.com/chordcommerce) maintains a fleet of Solidus extensions (solidus_stripe, solidus_braintree, solidus_paypal_braintree, solidus_subscriptions, solidus_virtual_gift_card, solidus_importer, solidus_avatax_certified), a consent-manager TypeScript library, a Jitsu fork for event ingestion, and example repos for eventing and analytics. Notable customers include Sonos, Blue Bottle Coffee, Rodan + Fields, MrBeast, and Ritual. Funding has come from M13 Ventures, Equal Ventures, Act One Ventures, Chingona Ventures, and CEAS Investments, with an $18M Series A reported by TechCrunch in 2021. The commercial model is sales-led with custom enterprise pricing gated behind a demo request.

providers.name: Focal Systems
providers.description: Focal Systems is a San Francisco-based deep-learning company building the operating system for brick-and-mortar retail. Its platform combines proprietary shelf-mounted computer-vision cameras, real-time AI, and streaming data to digitize physical stores hourly — tracking on-shelf availability, out-of-stocks, planogram and price-tag compliance, shrink, and inventory. Products include Computer Vision cameras, Shelf AI, the Action Tool associate mobile app, and the Impact analytics dashboard, used by leading grocery and retail chains such as Walmart Canada to reduce waste, redeploy labor, and recover lost sales. Focal Systems is a Y Combinator and Uncork Capital-backed company and operates as an enterprise SaaS vendor; it does not publish a public self-serve developer API or SDK.

providers.name: Indrive
providers.description: inDrive is a global ride-hailing, delivery, and urban-services platform built around a peer-to-peer, name-your-price model in which passengers propose a fare and nearby drivers accept, counter, or decline it directly. Founded in 2012 by Arsen Tomsky in Yakutsk, Russia and now headquartered in Mountain View, California, the company operates across roughly 48 countries and more than 1,000 cities, with over 400 million app downloads. Beyond city rides it offers intercity transport, courier and freight delivery, on-demand task services, and driver lending. inDrive was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bond Capital and General Catalyst. inDrive does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or a developer portal; its GitHub organization hosts internal engineering frameworks and an engineering handbook rather than external API definitions.

providers.name: Juleb
providers.description: Juleb is a Saudi Arabia-based pharma-tech and retail software company providing an integrated cloud platform for the health, retail, and distribution sectors. Its suite spans accounting and financial management, inventory and warehouse management, sales force automation (SFA), point of sale (POS), Rx e-prescription, e-commerce, and DSCSA regulatory compliance. Juleb connects to Saudi compliance systems (ZATCA/Fatoora, RSD, GS1, Wasfaty), e-commerce channels (Salla, Shopify, HungerStation), payment providers (Geidea, Alhamrani), and ERPs (Microsoft Dynamics). Founded by Yousuf Jamjoom and backed by 500 Global, Juleb exposes a REST API (documented at docs.juleb.com) covering inventory, point of sale, prescriptions, and partner/company resources.

providers.name: Tezbor, Inc.
providers.description: Tezbor is a Tashkent, Uzbekistan based courier and last-mile logistics company that automates the delivery of documents, parcels, and cargo across Uzbekistan. Beyond its consumer and business courier service, Tezbor operates a technology platform that exposes delivery ordering and tracking through an integration API, ready-made e-commerce plugins (WooCommerce, OpenCart, Magento), mobile apps, dashboards, and Telegram bots, so that any online store can automatically generate a Tezbor delivery order from each purchase. The company is backed by 500 Global, Activat, and StartupBase, and counts brands such as Beeline, Ozon, and OQ among its delivery clients.

providers.name: Deppon Express
providers.description: Deppon Express (德邦快递), operated by Deppon Logistics Co., Ltd., is a major Chinese express delivery and logistics provider specializing in large-parcel (heavy/bulky) express, less-than-truckload freight, full-truckload, air freight, warehousing, supply chain, and cross-border services. Founded from Cui's Freight Company (1996) and incorporated in 2009, it became part of the JD Logistics group in 2022 and ranks among China's largest express carriers by market share. For developers and enterprise partners, Deppon runs the Deppon Open Platform (德邦开放平台, established 2015) at dpopen.deppon.com, offering system-integration APIs for order creation, standard track/tracking queries, and electronic waybill (面单) printing, with access granted to contracted monthly-settlement customers.

providers.name: Reibus International
providers.description: Reibus International is an Atlanta, Georgia headquartered technology company operating a digital marketplace and open-deck freight logistics platform for the industrial metals industry. Reibus connects buyers and sellers of steel and other industrial metals with a curated network of international and domestic carriers, offering instant freight quotes, automated carrier assignment, and real-time shipment visibility tracking. The Reibus Logistics platform specializes in flatbed, dry van, and dray transportation across the contiguous United States, Canada, and Mexico, plus specialized services including oversized loads, team drivers, expedited shipping, cross-border logistics, high-value freight, and warehousing. Founded by CEO John Blount, Reibus operates across seven countries with business relationships spanning more than 25 nations and is backed by Battery Ventures. Reibus does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; customer-facing tools (instant quote, shipment visibility dashboard) are delivered through the app.reibus.com web application.

providers.name: Trace
providers.description: Trace (tracehq.com) is a workforce planning, headcount management, and procurement platform where companies plan and manage headcount as their most important investment, offering instant workforce analytics and headcount planning. Trace was backed by 500 Global and Uncork Capital, was acquired by Paylocity (now branded "TraceHQ, A Paylocity Company"), and the standalone Trace app is being sunset in early 2026 as the product folds into Paylocity for Finance headcount planning. Trace publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Whitespace
providers.description: Whitespace is an AI operating system for wholesale distributors, based in London and part of Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch. The platform connects to a distributor's existing business systems (ERPs such as SAP, NetSuite, Epicor, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and Sage, plus Salesforce, HubSpot, QuickBooks, Gmail and Outlook) to build a model of operations, then deploys self-improving AI agents that automate demand forecasting, inventory replenishment, order entry, quote generation, customer query responses, and accounts payable and receivable. It targets sectors including industrial supplies, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, building materials, foodservice, consumer goods and textiles. Founded by Alex Tung and Leon Yao. As an early-stage company it currently ships a product but publishes no public API, developer documentation or SDK.

providers.name: FlagshipRTL
providers.description: FlagshipRTL (Flagship) is a SaaS company providing AI-powered inventory forecasting and merchandise planning software for retail brands, with a focus on apparel and direct-to-consumer (DTC) businesses. Its platform pairs demand forecasting at size-level granularity with multi-scenario planning, a purchase-order (PO) builder, and real-time inventory alerts to help retailers reduce stockouts and maximize full-price sell-through. Flagship reports optimizing over $2B in GMV for customers such as Bala, Mack Weldon, and Fresh Clean Threads, and integrates with systems including Shopify, NetSuite, Cin7, Snowflake, and Google Sheets. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Focal Point Procurement Solutions
providers.description: Focal Point is an AI-powered procurement orchestration platform for enterprise procurement teams. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, the SaaS platform sits on top of a company's existing S2P and ERP systems to centralize procurement data, intake, and workflows across six core modules: Request Intake Management, Procurement Activity Management, Sourcing Event Management, Supplier Relationship Management, Third-Party Risk Management, and Contract Lifecycle Management. It connects existing systems and data via API integrations, automates tactical no-code workflows, and provides total spend visibility, intelligent intake, and smart routing so procurement teams can focus on strategic work. Focal Point does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal; integrations are delivered through the platform. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Open Port Technology
providers.description: Open Port Technology (OpenPort) is a pan-Asian logistics and supply chain technology company that digitizes trucking, freight, and supply chain operations across emerging markets through an open, neutral, AI-based platform. Headquartered in Karachi, Pakistan, its product suite spans transport management (OpenTM), a digital trucking marketplace (OpenMarket), customs clearance (OpenClear), warehouse picking operations (OpenPick), and FBR digital invoicing (Open Invoice). The company reports millions of completed shipments, 1,600+ transport partners, and integrations across 100+ ERP systems, offering ERP integration and custom API development to clients, though it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine readable API specification at this time.

providers.name: TradeLink
providers.description: TradeLink is a Munich-based logistics SaaS company building the first collaboration platform for supply chain and inbound/outbound logistics. Its cloud software gives warehouses, suppliers, carriers, and dispatchers a shared system for time-slot (dock) booking, dock and yard management, load-carrier and empties management, driver check-in terminals, and analytics insights, replacing phone and email coordination with real-time, transparent workflows. TradeLink integrates with existing ERP and transport-management systems and serves production, retail, and contract-logistics companies across the DACH region and Europe, with customers including MAN, SPAR, Liebherr, and Emons. It is backed by Insight Partners and Point Nine.

providers.name: Venwiz
providers.description: Venwiz is a Bengaluru, India based B2B digital platform for the procurement of industrial and infrastructural project services, covering both CapEx and MRO requirements for the manufacturing sector. Founded in 2020 by Rajesh Reddy and Sandesh Paturi, it operates a marketplace that connects industrial buyers with a verified, pan-India database of service vendors, adding vendor discovery, order expediting, project management tooling and vendor intelligence on top. Backed by Accel and other investors (~$11.4M raised), Venwiz digitises what has traditionally been an offline, relationship-driven industrial services procurement process. No public developer API, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, SDK, or documentation surface is published as of this enrichment pass; the public presence is a marketing/content website plus a login-gated application.

providers.name: Afresh Technologies
providers.description: Afresh Technologies builds an AI platform for grocery retail that helps supermarkets and distributors manage fresh food, reducing shrink, improving in-stock rates, and cutting food waste across store ordering, inventory management, production planning, recipe management, and distribution-center buying. Its machine-learning decision engine forecasts demand for perishable, random-weight, and bulk items where operational data is inherently messy, and is also offered as a backend Replenishment API that plugs Afresh's forecasting and ordering logic into a retailer's existing front-end systems without changing in-store associate workflows. The company is based in San Francisco and is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Reibus
providers.description: Reibus is a technology-enabled B2B platform for the industrial metals industry, originally a digital marketplace for buying and selling steel and other metals and now focused on open-deck freight logistics for shipping steel and industrial metals. Operating as Reibus Logistics, the company connects shippers with a vast network of international and domestic carriers across flatbed, dry van, and drayage modes, offering instant quoting, shipment visibility, and cross-border logistics in the US, Canada, and Mexico. Founded by CEO John Blount, Reibus operates in 7 countries, does business in 25+ countries, and is backed by Canaan Partners, Initialized Capital, and the SoftBank Vision Fund. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Core & Main
providers.description: Core & Main is a leading specialty distributor of water, wastewater, storm drainage, and fire protection products and related services to municipalities, contractors, and engineers across the United States. As a Fortune 500 company, Core & Main operates more than 320 branch locations and provides products and services for water infrastructure, geosynthetics, fusible HDPE pipe, smart metering, fire protection, and erosion control.

providers.name: Craftable
providers.description: Craftable is hospitality's back-office software platform for restaurants, bars, hotels, and resorts, originally known for its Bevager and Foodager products, that connects purchasing, inventory, recipes, and accounts payable with accounting and sales data. Its suite spans Intelligent Ordering (eProcurement), AP Automation with Invoice AI, Inventory and Recipe Management, and Daily Actionable Insights, plus AI features such as Operator AI and the Crafty in-app assistant. Craftable is SOC 2 compliant and SSO-capable, with more than 1,000 POS, EDI, and vendor/API integrations spanning systems such as Toast, Square, Lightspeed, Clover, SpotOn, TouchBistro, Aloha by NCR Voyix, Restaurant365, Sage Intacct, Oracle NetSuite, Acumatica, QuickBooks, and Xero. Craftable does not publish a public self-service developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; integrations are delivered through its implementation team during onboarding, and API access to a connected platform is provisioned by requesting a scoped API key from that platform's support team.

providers.name: Elektrik App
providers.description: Elektrik is a medium voltage (MV) equipment procurement platform for electrical distributors, contractors, and Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC) firms. Founded in 2020 by Mario Dealba out of the Techstars Alabama EnergyTech Accelerator, the company streamlines sourcing of medium- to high-voltage supplies (roughly 5kV-35kV / 600V-69kV) including MV cable, terminations, splices, deadbreak and loadbreak connectors, and transformers. Buyers build part lists and specifications in the web app and Elektrik surfaces matching products across leading manufacturers such as TE Connectivity, BURNDY, Richards Manufacturing, and PFISTERER, compressing a traditionally slow, quote-driven procurement cycle. Backed by Techstars and growth capital, Elektrik is added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI.

providers.name: Sprouts Farmers Market
providers.description: Sprouts Farmers Market is a specialty grocery retailer focused on fresh, natural, and organic foods at affordable prices. Operating primarily in the western United States, Sprouts integrates with third-party platforms including Instacart, DoorDash, and Uber Eats for online grocery delivery. Sprouts uses EDI-based supply chain integrations and participates in Instacart's AI-powered Cart Assistant program. There is no public developer API; integrations are handled through EDI and third-party delivery platform partnerships.

providers.name: WESCO International
providers.description: WESCO International is a Fortune 500 leading provider of business-to-business distribution, logistics services, and supply chain solutions for electrical, industrial, communications, and utility customers worldwide. WESCO serves over 150,000 customers through a network of branches and distribution centers and provides comprehensive digital integration capabilities including EDI, punchout, cXML, and API connectivity for procurement automation.

providers.name: Kaizntree Inc.
providers.description: Kaizntree is a New York-based operations platform for growth-stage consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands, giving multi-channel manufacturers and sellers a single system to run purchasing, inventory, sales, fulfillment, production, and lot-level traceability. Its two products are Kaizntree OS, a cloud ERP that centralizes stock across raw materials, intermediate goods, packaging, finished and bundled products with COGS, margin, multi-location, batch/expiry and audit-ready records, and JP, an ERP-agnostic AI operations assistant that automates high-volume workflows such as purchase-order processing, reporting, data synchronization, and OTIF tracking. Kaizntree integrates with sales channels (including Shopify), accounting, WMS, and fulfillment platforms. Backed by 500 Global (seed, 2022), it operates on usage-based pricing. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company; Kaizntree publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Onramp Payments
providers.description: Onramp Payments, Inc. (ONRAMP) is a fintech company building modern payments infrastructure for the commercial trucking and fleet industry. Founded by logistics and payments veterans and backed by Canaan Partners, the company operates an enterprise-grade digital platform that replaces legacy card-based fleet payment systems. For carriers it offers cardless fuel payments at the pump, administrative spend controls, and maintenance payment solutions; for merchants it provides digital payment acceptance, pricing controls, and fraud prevention that work both in-store and at fuel pumps; and for partners it offers API integrations, broker solutions, and Transportation Management System (TMS) connections. The company markets itself as the easiest, most secure payments platform for carriers and merchants and has raised roughly $21M from investors including Canaan Partners, CEAS Investments, Contour Venture Partners, Javelin Venture Partners, and RedBlue Capital. As of this enrichment pass ONRAMP publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or OpenAPI, so this profile captures verified company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Universal Forest Products
providers.description: UFP Industries (formerly Universal Forest Products) is a leading global manufacturer and distributor of wood and wood-alternative products serving retail, industrial, and construction markets. UFP operates over 200 facilities globally supplying lumber, engineered wood products, packaging, and building materials. The company has integrated OnBase-based business system integration for document management and workflow automation across its supply chain operations.

providers.name: Advantive
providers.description: Advantive is an AI-enabled software company for specialty manufacturing and distribution operations, unifying ERP, MES, quality (SPC/SQC), PLM, WMS, and B2B commerce workflows into industry-specific systems. Built from a portfolio of brands including Advantzware, DDI System, Distribution One, InfinityQS (Enact and ProFicient), Kiwiplan, WinSPC, and VIA, Advantive serves more than 2,500 customers across eight countries in verticals such as food and beverage, packaging (corrugated, folding carton, plastics), automotive, aerospace and defense, electronics, and distribution of fasteners, bearings, HVAC, and janitorial supplies. The company is a private-equity-backed operations software provider; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public digital surface. No public developer API or OpenAPI has been found — integration is delivered through the products' own connectors and the Advantive support portal.

providers.name: Apeel
providers.description: Apeel Sciences is a food technology company headquartered in Santa Barbara, California that develops plant-based protective coatings which extend the shelf life of fresh fruits and vegetables. The company uses food-grade ingredients derived from the peels, pulp, and seeds of plants to create a thin, edible layer that reinforces produce's natural peel, slowing water loss and oxidation. This extends peak taste, juiciness, and nutrient retention while reducing reliance on refrigeration, waxes, pesticides, and plastic packaging across the fresh-produce supply chain. Apeel positions itself as a sustainability and food-waste leader, reporting that since 2021 its technology has prevented millions of pieces of fruit from spoiling, avoided tens of thousands of metric tons of CO2-equivalent emissions, and conserved billions of liters of water. Its products have undergone regulatory review in the United States, European Union, and other markets. Apeel is a portfolio company of Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead. It publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification as of this profile.

providers.name: autone
providers.description: autone is an AI-powered inventory management platform for retail brands, blending machine-driven recommendations with merchandising expertise and a brand's own data to optimize stock decisions across buying, reordering, replenishment, and rebalancing. Its modules — Buy, Reorder, Replenish, Rebalance, Assortment & Initial Allocation, and Insights — help fashion, beauty, furniture, and sports retailers reduce stockouts and overstock, redistribute inventory across locations, and improve margins. Founded by supply-chain operators from luxury fashion houses (Alexander McQueen, Victoria Beckham, Givenchy), autone is backed by General Catalyst, Seedcamp, and Speedinvest. No public developer API or documentation is published at this time; the platform is delivered as an enterprise SaaS. This profile originated as a VC-portfolio lead and has been enriched with verifiable company identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Clarium
providers.description: Clarium is a healthcare supply chain resiliency company founded in early 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic and headquartered in New York City. Its AI-powered platform, Astra OS, unifies real-time data from hospitals and their suppliers across systems of record, then layers data-enabled workflow apps on top: Disruption Monitoring to detect and resolve supply chain disruptions faster, Substitute Management to automate product approvals, and Procedure Card Optimization to standardize and cut cost. Clarium has raised $43M+ (including a $27M Series A led by General Catalyst, with Northzone among its backers) and works with leading health systems such as Mount Sinai, Ochsner Health, Allina Health, and Yale New Haven.

providers.name: CoPlane
providers.description: CoPlane is a San Francisco-based enterprise software company building an AI-native intelligent operations layer for the back office of essential enterprises. The platform combines AI agents with deterministic business rules on a durable workflow engine to automate high-friction, exception-heavy processes across finance, procurement, and operations — including invoice intake, PO matching, vendor onboarding, cash application, billing, collections, bank and account reconciliation, close processes, and variance analysis. CoPlane runs inside the customer's own cloud environment and interoperates with existing enterprise systems (SAP, Workday, Coupa) across Source-to-Pay, Quote-to-Cash, and Record-to-Report workflows without a rip-and-replace migration. Founded in 2024, the company raised a $14M seed round in November 2025 led by Ribbit Capital with participation from Stripe, Optum Ventures, and Terrain. This profile was surfaced as a Ribbit Capital portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; CoPlane does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Elevarm
providers.description: Elevarm is an upstream-focused agritech company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Bandung, Indonesia, that elevates smallholder horticulture farmers across West Java, Central Java, and Yogyakarta. It aggregates and supports more than 15,000 farmers with high-quality inputs (premium greenhouse seedlings, bio-based fertilizers, and environmentally friendly pest control via its NextBio line), lab-based soil testing through Klinik Tani, an AI-powered farming productivity app for land monitoring and data-driven agronomy recommendations, pro-farmer financing, and the PasarAgri commodity trading platform that links supply to business buyers. Elevarm is backed by Intudo, Insignia Ventures Partners, and 500 Global.

providers.name: Evigence Sensors
providers.description: Evigence Sensors is a freshness-management technology company for the food industry, combining low-cost physical sensors with data analytics to monitor food quality in real time from production to consumption at the individual item level. Its time-temperature indicator technology powers both digital (QR-scan) and visual freshness indicators applied to retail units, serving food brands, retailers, foodservice operators, cold-chain logistics providers, and consumers across the supply chain. Evigence holds 27 granted patents and its indicators meet WHO time/temperature monitoring standards. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Evigence publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDK, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its verified public company properties only.

providers.name: Forum Mobility
providers.description: Forum Mobility develops, owns, and operates zero-emission heavy-duty trucking infrastructure, bundling electric Class 8 truck leases with charging subscriptions for a single monthly price so freight carriers of every size can electrify without upfront capital. The company builds and runs a network of charging depots — anchored by its flagship FM Harbor site at the Port of Long Beach (44 ports, 360KW fast chargers, 9MW capacity) — with additional depots in development across California and Nevada. Forum Mobility was surfaced as a portfolio company of obvious-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a physical-infrastructure operator with no public developer/API surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Geek+
providers.description: Geek+ (Geekplus, HKEX: 2590) is a global leader in AI-driven autonomous mobile robot (AMR) solutions for warehouse and logistics automation. Founded in 2015, it delivers end-to-end smart-warehouse systems spanning shelf-to-person (PopPick), tote-to-person (RoboShuttle), pallet-to-person (Skycube) storage and retrieval, robot-arm picking, sorting, and intralogistics transport. Its All-in-One Software Suite (Robot Management System, Warehouse Execution System, Intelligent Warehouse Management System, data and simulation platforms) exposes open REST APIs and SDKs so customers and partners can integrate robot fleets with major WMS, ERP, and MES platforms including SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Manhattan Associates, and Blue Yonder. Geek+ serves 3PL, retail, e-commerce, apparel, grocery, healthcare and pharma, manufacturing, automotive, electronics, and cold-chain logistics across 40+ countries, with 950+ deployed warehouses. In 2025 it became the world's first publicly listed AMR warehouse robotics company on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

providers.name: iMile
providers.description: iMile is a technology-driven last-mile delivery and e-commerce logistics company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Led by founder and CEO Rita Huang, iMile provides express parcel delivery, cash-on-delivery (COD), domestic and international express, dropshipping, order fulfillment, warehousing, storage, and reverse logistics / return management across more than 30 countries spanning the Middle East, China, Latin America, Africa, Europe, and Australia. The company operates its own routing, tracking, and delivery technology and employs over 20,000 people. iMile assigns each shipment a 13-digit tracking number; parcel tracking is available on imile.com and through major third-party tracking aggregators. iMile does not currently publish a first-party public developer API or open platform, so this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Revlon
providers.description: Revlon is a global beauty company whose portfolio spans color cosmetics, fragrance, skin care, hair color, hair care, beauty tools, and antiperspirants / deodorants. The company markets Revlon, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, Mitchum, Cutex, Charlie, SinfulColors, and Ultima II, along with a portfolio of licensed prestige and celebrity fragrance brands. Revlon Consumer Products Corporation filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the Southern District of New York on June 15, 2022 and emerged on May 2, 2023 as a privately held company controlled by its former lenders (including BrandCo noteholders such as King Street Capital, Glendon Capital, and Angelo Gordon), having cut roughly $2.7 billion of debt from its balance sheet. Today Revlon operates as a private company with reduced leverage, selling through mass-market retail and prestige channels worldwide. Revlon does not publish a public developer API; supplier, retailer, and partner integrations occur through private commercial channels (e-commerce platform integrations, EDI / GDSN feeds for retailers, and the corporate procurement portal).

providers.name: Robust.AI
providers.description: Robust.AI is a robotics company building Carter, an AI-powered collaborative mobile robot for warehouse fulfillment and manufacturing environments. Founded by Rodney Brooks (co-founder of iRobot and Rethink Robotics) and colleagues, the company designs human-centered autonomous material-handling robots that work alongside people with minimal infrastructure change, no capital expenditure, and rapid ROI. Robust.AI is backed by Playground Global and was recognized among Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026. This is a physical-robotics company; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or GitHub surface.

providers.name: Shopeando
providers.description: Shopeando is a Mexican technology and logistics startup that manages the full international shipping process, enabling businesses and individuals to import and export merchandise between China, Europe, the United States and Mexico. Through its platform it coordinates cross-border logistics, customs handling and last-mile delivery, and provides dedicated import, export and e-commerce fulfillment services for online stores. Shopeando is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Viewlocity
providers.description: Viewlocity Technologies Pty Ltd is a supply chain management software company that provides supply chain visibility, control tower, and execution solutions for global manufacturers, distributors, and logistics providers. Its solution set spans supply chain design, inventory and asset management, supply chain management, logistics and transportation, planning and production, order lifecycle management, and supplier management, delivered as SaaS and managed services to industries including aerospace and defense, automotive and industrial, consumer goods, high tech and electronics, manufacturing, retail, and third-party logistics. Viewlocity publishes a corporate marketing and resource website but does not expose a public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Cargo X
providers.description: Cargo X (CargoX) is a Sao Paulo based Brazilian logistics technology and fintech company, founded in 2013, that operates one of Brazil's largest digital freight marketplaces - matching shippers (embarcadores) with carriers (transportadoras) and independent truck drivers. Beyond freight brokerage the platform provides dedicated freight desk operations, driver qualification and real-time cargo monitoring, automated issuance of Brazilian transport tax documents (CT-e and MDF-e), cargo insurance, receivables financing and working-capital credit for carriers, and green-freight / ESG programs that reduce empty return trips. The company reached unicorn status with a USD 200M Series F in October 2021 co-led by Tencent and SoftBank, with Valor Capital Group, Lightrock and Oikos participating.

providers.name: CargoWise
providers.description: CargoWise is WiseTech Global's logistics execution platform - a single-database ERP for international freight forwarding, customs, warehousing, transport, and landside logistics. Its integration surface is delivered primarily through eAdaptor, which pairs a RESTful XML inbound service (push, query, add, and update records) with a SOAP-based outbound service (a webhook equivalent that emits messages on milestones). Payloads use CargoWise's Universal XML schemas - Universal Shipment (XUS), Universal Event (XUE), and Universal Transaction - or the legacy Native XML format. Newer REST integration (eAdaptor Next / xHub) adds OAuth 2.0 authorization-code access. The integration API is real but heavily gated - the eAdaptor Developers Guide and endpoint details are released only after a customer purchases the eAdaptor modules, and partner access runs through WiseTech accreditation and certification. Endpoints below are modeled from public developer references; the authoritative specification is not publicly published.

providers.name: Carahsoft
providers.description: Carahsoft Technology Corp. is a master government IT solutions aggregator and distributor that resells software, cloud, and cybersecurity products from hundreds of technology vendors to U.S. federal, state, local, defense, intelligence, healthcare, and education customers across 220+ government contract vehicles. Carahsoft operates a partner-facing Developer Center that exposes partner integrations for accounts, quotes, orders, invoices, price lists, purchase orders, and resources; the underlying API is gated behind a partner account and is not a public REST API.

providers.name: Evri
providers.description: Evri is the United Kingdom's largest dedicated parcel delivery company, formerly Hermes UK, headquartered in Leeds and majority owned by Apollo-managed funds. Following the CMA-cleared 2025 merger with DHL eCommerce UK, the combined group delivers more than a billion parcels a year across a courier network of 30,000+ couriers and van drivers, thousands of ParcelShops and lockers, and domestic, returns and international services for retailers and marketplace sellers. Evri sits at the last-mile end of the supply chain — the carrier a shipper, retailer or e-commerce platform hands a parcel to for final delivery in the UK. Its API posture is customer-contract portal only: Evri publishes no developer portal, no public API reference and no machine-readable specification. The host api.evri.com resolves to a live Tyk API Gateway (5.13.0) whose only publicly reachable path is an unauthenticated health check; every other probed path returns 404 and no listen path is discoverable without credentials. Shipment, label, ParcelShop, Print in Store and tracking credentials are issued by an Evri account manager or sales representative to contracted Corporate or Business accounts, with sandbox and production credentials handed over by email. In practice most integrators reach Evri indirectly through shipping-API aggregators such as EasyPost, ShipEngine / ShipStation, Sendcloud, AfterShip and Intersoft Sapient rather than directly.

providers.name: Sales Patriot
providers.description: SalesPatriot deploys artificial intelligence into enterprise supply chain operations, embedding engineers onsite to build custom AI solutions that integrate fragmented business systems (ERP, CRM, email, spreadsheets, and supplier portals) and automate routine workflows. The platform aggregates data from scattered sources into a unified, searchable system, automates tasks such as quoting, sourcing, and data entry, and visualizes real-time operational metrics for executives. It serves defense contracting and procurement, complex multi-source procurement operations, and high-volume distribution. SalesPatriot is a portfolio company of CRV. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network and enriched by the pipeline; the company publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Alta Resource Technologies
providers.description: Alta Resource Technologies is a Colorado-based deep-tech company reinventing how critical minerals are sourced. It uses advanced biochemistry — customizable, engineered proteins licensed from Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory and co-developed with researchers at Pennsylvania State University — to selectively separate high-purity rare earth elements and other strategic metals from low-grade ores, mining tailings, and electronic-waste streams such as end-of-life hard disk drives. The protein-based platform binds target elements out of complex, low-concentration solutions with high selectivity while dramatically reducing the environmental footprint of conventional mining and refining, strengthening U.S. and allied critical-mineral supply chains. Alta emerged from stealth in January 2025 and expanded its Series Seed to $10M, backed by DCVC, Voyager Ventures, In-Q-Tel, and Orion Industrial Ventures. As a materials-science and biochemistry company, Alta does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this API Evangelist profile carries its identity and website properties only.

providers.name: Collectiv Food
providers.description: Collectiv Food is a next-generation B2B food wholesaler serving professional kitchens across the UK and France. Launched in London in 2022, it combines collective buying power, consolidated deliveries, and direct sourcing through a shortened, patented supply-chain model to supply restaurants, hotels, and caterers with meat, fish, plant-based proteins, dairy, produce, dry and frozen goods, and prepared items. The company emphasizes traceability, responsible sourcing, and sustainability, and is B-Corp certified with an EcoVadis Gold rating. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public API or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Cosmart
providers.description: Cosmart is an Indonesian membership-only B2B e-commerce and procurement platform, founded in 2021 by Alvin Kumarga and Robert Tan, where members (individuals and SMEs) purchase their recurring daily and business needs in larger quantities at competitive prices. The platform lists over 100,000 products across categories including office supplies, electronics, household items, automotive parts, industrial equipment, furniture, and services, with nationwide delivery, flexible payment terms, and dedicated relationship managers for corporate clients. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Lightspeed India Partners. Cosmart does not publish a public developer program, API, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: J&T Express
providers.description: J&T Express (J&T Global Express Ltd, HKEX: 1519) is a global logistics service operator whose core business is express parcel delivery and international logistics. Founded in Indonesia in 2015, it operates express delivery networks across 13 countries including Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand, Cambodia, Singapore, China, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Mexico, Brazil, and Egypt, with international freight services reaching Asia, Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Oceania. The company serves e-commerce sellers and consumers with parcel pickup, sorting, line-haul, last-mile delivery, and track-and-trace. As of this profile J&T Express publishes a public track-and-trace web experience and regional merchant onboarding, but no public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI definition was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain security.

providers.name: Reliance Steel & Aluminum
providers.description: Reliance Steel & Aluminum Co. is the largest metals service center in North America, providing value-added metals processing services and distributing a full line of metal products including aluminum, brass, bronze, carbon and alloy steel, copper, titanium, and stainless steel. Operating over 300 service center locations across 40 US states and 13 countries, Reliance serves more than 130,000 customers across aerospace, automotive, defense, energy, electronics, construction, and semiconductor end markets.

providers.name: Savi Technology
providers.description: Savi Technology provides Internet of Things (IoT) and active RFID (aRFID) solutions for real-time supply chain visibility, asset tracking, and cargo security. Combining active RFID tags, environmental condition sensors, and machine intelligence, Savi delivers location, condition, and estimated-time- of-arrival data for cargo and high-value assets across government, military (including U.S. Department of Defense in-transit visibility), and commercial supply chains. The company is headquartered in Wilmington, North Carolina. As of this enrichment pass, Savi Technology exposes no public developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, SDKs, or documented web API; its only authenticated surface is the aRFID-VI customer catalog (savirfidcatalog.net).

providers.name: Scalera
providers.description: Scalera AG is a Swiss construction-technology company building an AI platform that automates the tender and quotation process for the construction industry across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland). Its product-matching engine extracts positions from tender documents (PDF, GAEB, Excel/CSV, XML, email) and matches them against supplier product catalogs, while its supplier-matching tools help contractors identify relevant manufacturers and send structured inquiries. Scalera integrates with ERP, CRM, and PIM systems and serves 200+ manufacturers, processors, and traders. Backed by Speedinvest, it positions itself as one of Europe's most funded construction-tech startups. This profile documents the company's public web surface; no public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Silo
providers.description: Silo is a cloud-based ERP platform built specifically for the fresh-produce supply chain, serving growers, packers, shippers, and distributors. The platform unifies produce operations across five modules - a diversified produce ERP, labor and asset management, payments and financial operations, EDI and traceability, and analytics and intelligence - to improve operational efficiency and financial visibility for small to midsize produce businesses. Silo is backed by a16z and Initialized Capital. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Snowman
providers.description: Snowman Logistics is an Indian integrated cold-chain and temperature-controlled logistics company headquartered in Bengaluru, providing refrigerated (frozen and chilled) warehousing, cold storage, and distribution services across India. It serves frozen and chilled foods, dairy, seafood, quick-service restaurants, pharmaceuticals, and other perishables through a national network of temperature-controlled warehouses and a refrigerated transportation fleet. The company is publicly listed on Indian exchanges and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the enrichment pass confirmed the company publishes a marketing/corporate website (snowman.in) but exposes no public developer, API, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: MWI Veterinary Supply
providers.description: MWI Veterinary Supply, a subsidiary of AmerisourceBergen, is a leading distributor of animal health products to veterinarians across the United States and the United Kingdom, providing pharmaceuticals, vaccines, supplies, diagnostics, and practice management software to veterinary practices.

providers.name: Carnot Fleet
providers.description: Carnot Fleet (Carnotfleet) is a Seoul-based cold-chain technology company that converts non-refrigerated vehicles into temperature-controlled units in under 30 minutes using modular insulation panels and proprietary solid-state thermoelectric heat pumps, spanning frozen, chilled, and ambient ranges with humidity control. Its Adaptive Thermal Control System (ATCS) is an AI-based autonomous control platform delivering cloud-connected temperature monitoring at 10-second intervals. Carnot Fleet surfaces its capabilities through the CF Mobile Application, the CF Portal, and CF APIs that let customers integrate the ATCS into existing logistics solutions to detect, analyze, prevent, and discover cold-chain data points and reduce post-harvest to pre-retail loss across the supply chain.

providers.name: Colgate-Palmolive
providers.description: Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer-products manufacturer operating in oral care, personal care, home care, and pet nutrition through brands such as Colgate, Palmolive, Hill's Pet Nutrition, Speed Stick, Ajax, and Softsoap. Colgate-Palmolive does not publish a general-purpose public developer REST API. Its B2B integration footprint is centered on EDI exchanges with retail trading partners (X12 messages, AS2, VAN), supplier integrations through SAP Ariba, and internal corporate systems. There is also a corporate sustainability and ESG reporting surface, but it is not exposed as a developer API.

providers.name: Covariant
providers.description: Covariant is an Emeryville, California warehouse-robotics AI company founded in 2017 (originally as Embodied Intelligence) by UC Berkeley professor Pieter Abbeel and his former students Peter Chen, Rocky Duan, and Tianhao Zhang. The company builds the Covariant Brain, a universal AI platform that enables industrial picking robots to handle virtually any SKU regardless of shape, size, or packaging, and in March 2024 it introduced RFM-1 (Robotics Foundation Model 1), an 8-billion-parameter multimodal transformer trained on text, images, video, robot actions, and numerical sensor readings to give robots human-like reasoning over the physical world. Covariant ships AI-powered solutions for order picking, sortation, item induction, kitting, depalletization, and goods-to-person workflows, delivered through long-running integration partnerships with KNAPP (Pick-it-Easy Robot, since 2020) and ABB (warehouse robotics, since 2020), as well as deployments with retailers and logistics providers worldwide. In August 2024, Amazon announced a non-exclusive license to Covariant's robotic foundation models and hired its three co-founders along with roughly a quarter of its workforce in a reverse-acquihire arrangement; Covariant continues to operate independently under COO-turned-CEO Ted Stinson and co-founder Tianhao Zhang. The Covariant Brain and RFM-1 are proprietary, deployed on-premise on partner robotics hardware, and the company has no public developer API, SDK, open-source release, or third-party developer program.

providers.name: Symbotic
providers.description: Symbotic is an AI-powered warehouse automation company that designs, manufactures, and operates end-to-end robotic distribution and micro-fulfillment systems for food and beverage, retail grocery, healthcare, apparel, retail general merchandise, and consumer packaged goods customers. Its portfolio includes the Symbotic distribution solution for case handling, SymMicro for less-than-case micro-fulfillment, autonomous SymBots mobile robots, warehouse AI software, and Warehouse-as-a-Service offerings. Symbotic operates as a hardware-and-services vendor and does not publish a public developer portal or open APIs.

providers.name: Watsco
providers.description: Watsco, Inc. is the world's largest distributor of air conditioning, heating, and refrigeration (HVAC/R) equipment and related products. Operating through subsidiaries including Carrier Enterprise, Baker Distributing, Gemaire Distributors, and East Coast Metal Distributors, Watsco serves contractors and dealers across more than 670 locations in the US, Canada, Mexico, and the Caribbean. The company has undergone significant digital transformation, running a unified B2B e-commerce platform powered by Magento Commerce and a centralized PIM system covering approximately 900,000 SKUs.

providers.name: Normative
providers.description: Normative is a Stockholm, Sweden-based carbon accounting and ESG reporting software company helping enterprises measure, report, and reduce their greenhouse gas emissions across scopes 1, 2, and 3. Its platform combines a library of more than 349,000 region- and sector-specific emission factors with workflows for product carbon footprint (PCF), supply chain engagement, Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) target setting, Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) disclosure, and Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) reporting. Calculations are built to the GHG Protocol and independently verified by TÜV SÜD against ISO/IEC 25051. Customers include Vodafone, Hertz, Hitachi Rail, and Flying Tiger Copenhagen, and every account is paired with a named, GHG Protocol-certified Climate Strategy Advisor rather than a traditional support helpdesk. The company's revenue model is enterprise SaaS subscriptions plus advisory services; Normative does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and its GitHub organization (normative-io) currently exposes no public repositories.

providers.name: Terrascope
providers.description: Terrascope is a Singapore-headquartered climate-tech and sustainability software company building an enterprise carbon measurement, management, and decarbonization platform. Launched in 2022 after being incubated and spun out of Olam Group (a Temasek-linked Singapore agribusiness), and led by former Google and AWS executive Felipe Daguila, Terrascope serves large food, agriculture, retail, and manufacturing enterprises that need to quantify Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions across their operations, products, and supply chains. The platform centers on four core modules: Corporate Carbon Footprint (CCF) for organization-level inventories, Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) for product-level lifecycle emissions, Supplier Engagement for Scope 3 primary-data collection, and Climate Reporting for audit-ready disclosure. Terrascope's differentiator is its AI-assisted data ingestion layer (built on Amazon Bedrock) that reduces measurement cycles by roughly 80% versus manual baselines, intelligent emissions factor matching with FLAG (Forestry, Land, and Agriculture) breakdowns, data gap-filling claiming 92% accuracy versus supplier data, and a curated library of over 20,000 decarbonization best practices used to power what-if scenario modeling and ROI-ranked recommendations. The platform supports the GHG Protocol (including Land Sector and Removals guidance), SBTi FLAG, CDP (Terrascope is a CDP Gold Accredited software provider), TCFD, California SB253, and Australia's S2 climate disclosure regimes. Notable customers include Kellanova, Princes Group, iNova Pharmaceuticals, Mandai Wildlife Group, Olam Food Ingredients, Tetra Pak, Mitsubishi, Japan Tobacco, and Kagome. Investors include Olam Group and Plug and Play Tech Center. Terrascope is delivered as a closed enterprise SaaS — there is no publicly documented developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, or open-source release. The github.com/terrascope organization exists but has no public repositories, and docs.terrascope.com is not publicly resolvable. Integration with customer ERP, procurement, and energy systems is handled through bespoke implementation engagements rather than self-serve developer onboarding.

providers.name: Chiquita Brands International
providers.description: Chiquita Brands International is a leading global producer, marketer, and distributor of bananas and other fresh produce, recognized worldwide by the iconic Blue Sticker on its bananas. Founded in 1899 as the United Fruit Company and rebranded as Chiquita in 1990, the company is headquartered in Etoy, Switzerland (with significant operations in Fort Lauderdale, Florida) and sources fruit from plantations across Latin America (Honduras, Guatemala, Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, and Ecuador) for distribution in the United States, Europe, and other markets. Beyond core Cavendish bananas, Chiquita markets specialty banana varieties (organic, Reds, Manzanos, Minis), plantains, pineapples (including the Sunburst Gold variety), and partners with retailers worldwide. Chiquita does not currently publish a consumer-facing developer API; supplier, retailer, and grower integrations are managed through internal portals and bilateral EDI systems, and consumer-facing digital experiences focus on recipes, sticker collection campaigns, and retail merchandising.

providers.name: Cleveland-Cliffs
providers.description: Cleveland-Cliffs is North America's largest flat-rolled steel producer and supplier of iron ore pellets, operating an integrated business spanning mining, steelmaking, and downstream finishing for the automotive, infrastructure, and manufacturing markets. Cleveland-Cliffs does not publish a public developer portal or general-purpose REST API surface. Programmatic interaction with the company is limited to investor and customer touchpoints (corporate website, investor relations, customer service, EDI for trading partners).

providers.name: Coty
providers.description: Coty Inc. is one of the world's largest beauty companies with an iconic portfolio of brands across fragrance, color cosmetics, skin and body care. The company operates two divisions: Prestige (premium fragrance, cosmetics, and skincare brands such as Gucci, Burberry, Calvin Klein, Hugo Boss, Marc Jacobs, Tiffany, Chloe, Davidoff, Lancaster, philosophy, and Kylie Cosmetics) and Consumer Beauty (mass-market color cosmetics, hair care, and body care brands such as CoverGirl, Rimmel, Max Factor, Sally Hansen, Bourjois, and Adidas). Coty does not publish a public developer API; supplier and partner integrations occur through the Coty Supplier Portal and B2B / EDI channels.

providers.name: Gather AI
providers.description: Gather AI is a Physical AI platform for logistics that gives warehouses dock-to-dock inventory visibility. Cameras mounted on autonomous drones and forklifts capture inventory, and computer vision extracts structured data (LPNs, UPCs, lot codes, and free text) from the imagery. Its Sage AI engine analyzes operations and surfaces prioritized actions before each shift, while automated Workflows route tasks to the right personnel across integrated systems. The plug-and-play solution deploys in hours alongside existing warehouse management systems, serving manufacturing, healthcare, food & beverage, retail, and 3PL operations. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and bloomberg-beta.

providers.name: Grubmarket
providers.description: GrubMarket is a food technology company founded in 2014 that digitally transforms the American food supply chain across the U.S. and Canada. It operates a B2B wholesale eCommerce marketplace connecting buyers to thousands of food products, an AI-powered ERP and warehouse-management software suite (WholesaleWare) for food distributors and growers, and a direct-to-consumer farm-fresh food delivery service. Backed by Battery Ventures, GGV Capital, and Y Combinator, GrubMarket was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass GrubMarket publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Shiplyst
providers.description: Shiplyst is an India-based ocean freight procurement marketplace and supply-chain technology platform that lets exporters and importers search and compare container shipping rates from 50+ ocean carriers in real time, generate instant quotes, book containers with transparent pricing, and track cargo from pickup to delivery. The platform automates Bill of Lading and invoice generation and offers real-time tracking with exception alerts across its web and mobile apps. Shiplyst is backed by 500 Global. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Suplari
providers.description: Suplari is an enterprise procurement intelligence platform that goes beyond spend analytics, using AI to clean, classify, and unify fragmented spend data across ERP, P2P, and spreadsheet sources. It delivers spend analytics, value orchestration, savings tracking, contract intelligence, and ESG intelligence, alongside procurement-specific AI agents (Suplari Worker, Assistant, and AI Studio) that integrate with SAP, Oracle, Workday, Coupa, Databricks, Snowflake, and Microsoft. Suplari was acquired by Microsoft in 2021. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Dexory
providers.description: Dexory is a UK-based warehouse intelligence and robotics company whose DexoryView platform pairs fleets of autonomous mobile scanning robots with physical AI to deliver real-time "ground truth" visibility across warehouses and distribution centers. The robots autonomously scan more than 10,000 pallet locations per hour and up to 18 meters of racking height, building a live digital twin that feeds AI-driven analytics for inventory accuracy, space and slotting optimization, damage/compliance detection, and operational performance. DexoryView is organized into modules (Integrity for stock accuracy and automated cycle counts, Optimise for space and productivity analytics, and Adapt for real-time operational response) and connects into existing warehouse and ERP systems such as SAP EWM, Manhattan, Blue Yonder, and Körber through pre-built connectors. Dexory serves 3PL logistics, manufacturing, food & beverage, retail, pharma, and air cargo operators. Added to the API Evangelist network from Atomico's portfolio and enriched via the pipeline; Dexory does not currently publish a public developer portal or OpenAPI.

providers.name: Jet2
providers.description: Jet2 plc (London Stock Exchange: JET2, formerly Dart Group plc) is a British leisure travel group headquartered at Low Fare Finder House, Leeds Bradford Airport, Yeadon, Leeds, West Yorkshire — an address confirmed verbatim in the Extended Validation TLS certificate served by www.jet2.com, issued to "JET2.COM LIMITED", company serial number 02739537, jurisdiction GB. Its home market is the United Kingdom. The group combines two businesses that are unusual in this sector for being deliberately fused: Jet2.com (IATA code LS, ICAO code EXS), the UK's third-largest airline, and Jet2holidays, the UK's largest ATOL holder and leading provider of ATOL-protected package holidays to the Mediterranean, the Canary Islands and European city destinations. For the year ended 31 March 2026 the group reported revenue of £7,482.1 million, operating profit of £439.6 million and a record 20.83 million passengers, flying from 14 UK airport bases including newly added London Luton and London Gatwick, with more than 63% of flown passengers buying an end-to-end package holiday and 155 Airbus A321neo aircraft on order. Jet2holidays sells through its own website and through more than 2,500 independent UK travel agent partners, and carries ABTA number Y1256. Where Jet2 sits in the distribution chain is the point of this record. Like easyJet and Ryanair, Jet2.com was built with no Global Distribution System dependency at all: it never filed fares into the GDS rail that Amadeus, Sabre and Travelport have intermediated for forty years, and it therefore never needed IATA's New Distribution Capability as a remedy. Travelport supports Jet2 in Smartpoint only as a "Direct Payment Carrier" — its low-cost-carrier workaround — point-to-point only, no connecting flights, and with no post-booking change or cancellation possible through the GDS at all ("Requests for changes must be made directly through Jet2"). In June 2025 Jet2.com signed a distribution agreement with airline technology company Kyte, whose Kyte Direct Connect (KDC) JSON/REST API "standardises airline NDC and LCC proprietary content", opening Jet2 seats and ancillaries to travel management companies and corporate booking tools for the first time, with the same content reaching agency desktops through AirGateway. Separately, Jet2holidays operates an agency API that lets independent agents sell Jet2 packages on their own bookable websites for commission. Its API posture, stated honestly, is that Jet2 runs real production distribution APIs and publishes nothing about them. There is no developer portal — developer.jet2.com, developers.jet2.com, docs.jet2.com, apis.jet2.com, ndc.jet2.com, partner.jet2.com and trade.jet2.com all fail to resolve — no API reference, no OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI or GraphQL contract, no security.txt, no .well-known catalogue and no official GitHub organisation. api.jet2.com resolves and answers HTTP 200 with nothing but the stock Microsoft IIS 10.0 default page, 404 on every spec path probed. Access is by commercial agreement only, negotiated bilaterally or through Kyte, whose own FAQ states that "Access to airline products is controlled by each airline." This record is an honest stub: apis[] is intentionally empty because no Jet2 API is publicly documented, and listing an undocumented hostname as an API would be fabrication. The evidence, including every URL probed with its HTTP status, is in review.yml. A second enrichment pass on 28 July 2026 found the one genuinely public first-party developer surface Jet2 has, and it is not an API: the Jet2 Design System, published as two npm packages under the @jet2 scope (design tokens for seven brand themes, and a React component library containing a single Button), sourced from Jet2's private Azure DevOps organisation at jet2tfs.visualstudio.com/Jet2Digital and documented at design.jet2.com behind a Supernova login. Both packages were last published in April 2024. The same pass confirmed no /.well-known/ document on any host that answers, no security.txt, no vulnerability disclosure programme, no trust centre, no public Postman collection and no SDK in any package registry. Jet2's engineering voice, such as it is, comes from Jet2 Travel Technologies (J2TT), its in-house development centre in Pune, India, which runs a public blog with an RSS feed.

providers.name: Reliance, Inc.
providers.description: Reliance, Inc. (NYSE: RS) is the largest metals service center operator in North America, distributing approximately 100,000 metal products across aluminum, brass, alloy, copper, carbon steel, stainless steel, titanium, and specialty metals to over 125,000 customers including fabricators and manufacturers. Operating under more than 75 distinct brands across 300+ locations in the US, Canada, and internationally, Reliance provides value-added processing services including cutting, shearing, sawing, leveling, stamping, and just-in-time delivery for aerospace, automotive, construction, defense, energy, electronics, and semiconductor end markets.

providers.name: COSCO Shipping
providers.description: A Chinese state-owned multinational shipping and logistics conglomerate and the world's largest container shipping fleet by capacity. Operates container shipping, port terminals, bulk cargo services, and digital supply chain platforms (Syncon Hub, My Reefer, Hi-Dolphin) across global trade routes.

providers.name: Vendease
providers.description: Vendease is a Nigerian B2B food procurement platform (founded 2020, Y Combinator W21, backed by Partech Africa and TLcom) that helps restaurants, hotels, and other food businesses buy fresh and processed food supplies, offering Buy Now, Pay Later financing, supplier consolidation, cold-chain logistics, and 24-hour delivery in Lagos. Vendease publishes no public developer API or SDKs; its procurement, payments, inventory, and tenant management service APIs are internal-only, though its engineering handover documentation is publicly available on GitHub.

providers.name: Via Global Health
providers.description: Via Global Health (VIA Global Health) is a medical equipment and pharmaceutical supplier serving distributors, healthcare providers, and NGOs across Africa, Asia, and Latin America. The company sources quality diagnostic equipment, surgical instruments, maternal and reproductive health devices, infection control and sterilization equipment, cold chain and laboratory supplies, and pharmaceutical-grade consumables from vetted manufacturers, and handles logistics, compliance, and last-mile delivery for low-resource health settings. Buyers request USD-priced quotes on any product page and receive a response within 24 hours, guided by an AI assistant named Amara. It is a quote-and-fulfillment marketplace with no publicly documented developer API surface; a private, robots-disallowed /api/* backs the storefront only. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Burt
providers.description: Burt builds AI teammates (AI coworkers) for logistics, aimed at freight brokers and forwarders. Its agents automate the repetitive, manual work of daily freight operations — track and trace, quoting, scheduling, carrier booking, document processing, proof-of-delivery chasing, and invoice and data entry — so human operators can focus on customer relationships and growing the business. Burt gives full visibility into every AI action with human oversight and approval workflows, rolls out autonomy gradually, and learns from operator corrections and exceptions to build institutional knowledge over time. Burt is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Y Combinator and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Burt does not currently publish a public developer/API surface.

providers.name: Ordermark
providers.description: Ordermark is a restaurant technology company that consolidates online food delivery and takeout orders from third-party channels such as DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, and Postmates into a single dashboard and printer, with menu synchronization, order management, and analytics across delivery partners and 250+ POS systems. Ordermark was acquired by and now operates under UrbanPiper; the ordermark.com property is maintained by UrbanPiper. As of this enrichment pass Ordermark publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs on its own surface. It was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company lead.

providers.name: Plus
providers.description: Plus (PlusAI) develops AI-based autonomous driving technology for commercial trucks. Its flagship SuperDrive is an AI-powered Level 4 autonomous driving system, and HyperFoundry is an integrated development platform for Physical AI. Plus works through partnerships with truck OEMs including TRATON GROUP, Hyundai, and IVECO rather than shipping a public developer API. Backed by GGV Capital, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; this enrichment pass confirmed it exposes no public API, SDK, or developer portal surface, and captured its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Rainmarket
providers.description: Rainmarket is the flagship intelligence platform of Digital Media Nusantara (DMN), built to map and illuminate cross-border trade flows between ASEAN and Hong Kong's Greater Bay Area. It combines three integrated engines — Supply Chain Intelligence, a Tariff Tracker, and a Trade Flows Mapping engine — to turn roughly USD100 billion in previously unmapped or mispriced regional trade activity into investible, financeable, and transparently governed flows. The platform is architected for sovereign-grade deployment, targeting the security, compliance, and resiliency thresholds required by central banks, financial regulators, and national-level intelligence environments, and serves institutional investors, financial institutions, market regulators, and enterprise treasury and supply-chain teams. Rainmarket was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network. As of this pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable service surface.

providers.name: Thirdwave
providers.description: Thirdwave (Third Wave Automation) builds autonomous material-handling systems for warehouses and distribution centers, led by its shared-autonomy forklift platform where one human operator can supervise a fleet of self-driving forklifts that operate independently and hand control back to a person when needed. Its ArmadaFMS (Armada Fleet Management System) software coordinates the robotic fleet across facilities. The company is a venture-backed logistics-robotics provider (backed by Homebrew and Norwest Venture Partners). As of this enrichment pass Third Wave publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Veluga
providers.description: Veluga (Veluga Brewery Inc.) is a South Korean B2B alcohol wholesale distribution platform that connects hospitality business owners with liquor suppliers. Operating from Mapo, Seoul, the company runs a wholesale marketplace offering real-time wholesale pricing quotes for spirits and craft beverages, product recommendations for business owners, wholesale order facilitation, and partnership programs for distributors and catering services. Veluga positions itself as a transaction and information intermediary rather than a direct seller. The company began as a craft-beer and snack subscription service and is backed by 500 Global, Kakao Ventures, SparkLabs, HL Holdings, and Sema Investment. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures the company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Wheelocity
providers.description: Wheelocity (Wheelocity Fresh Private Limited) is a Bangalore, India based logistics and supply-chain company building daily fresh-produce and grocery delivery networks for underserved rural markets across India, which it frames as "the access rails for Bharat commerce." Its phygital (online plus offline) model combines location intelligence, IoT hardware, cold-chain and predictive demand forecasting with an electric-vehicle first-mile and last-mile fleet and a consumer app branded WoW. The company reports serving more than one million households, running over 100,000 km of EV movement daily and avoiding tens of thousands of kilograms of produce waste each day. Wheelocity is a venture-backed operating company (Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio) and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Aruna
providers.description: Aruna is Indonesia's largest integrated fisheries commerce platform, on a mission to make the sea a better livelihood for all by building a fair and sustainable fisheries ecosystem. Aruna connects more than 40,000 small-scale fishermen to domestic and global markets using technology, a network of processing partners, and 177+ distribution hubs (Aruna Hubs) across the Indonesian archipelago, trading 23+ seafood commodity types into 31+ countries. The company pairs commerce with sustainability work, including fisherman education, fish-population tracking, and coastal-community empowerment. Aruna is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: FarMart
providers.description: FarMart is an AI-powered food sourcing and procurement platform that connects suppliers, food manufacturers, processors, and logistics providers across the global food and energy supply chain. It provides end-to-end procurement infrastructure including verified supplier discovery, five-minute AI-powered KYC verification, compliance management, market-to-factory batch traceability, automated invoicing and e-way bill generation, and real-time payment settlement in one to four hours. FarMart serves food companies, HoReCa (hospitality) buyers, and bio-fuel supply chains, with a network spanning 100+ premium buyers, 50+ food categories, and 10,000+ suppliers.

providers.name: Logixboard
providers.description: Logixboard provides a unified, white-labeled customer experience platform for freight forwarders and logistics service providers, letting their customers book, track, quote, and manage shipments across ocean, air, FTL/LTL, customs, and warehousing from a single branded portal. It ingests and normalizes shipment data from TMS and WMS systems (CargoWise, Descartes, homegrown systems) via private API, file drop (FTP/SFTP), and database sync, so providers can differentiate on digital visibility. Logixboard exposes no public developer API; integrations are delivered as bespoke, provider-scoped data connections. Added to the API Evangelist network from the venture portfolios of Insight Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and Techstars.

providers.name: Nomagic
providers.description: Nomagic builds Physical AI for end-to-end warehouse automation, using AI-powered robotic arms and computer vision to automate picking, packing, sorting and other fulfillment tasks across e-commerce, fashion, pharmaceutical and third-party logistics warehouses. Nomagic exposes a standard Station API for systems integrators, WCS/WMS providers and customers to control its robots, and a Grip AI API that adds an intelligence layer to third-party robot hardware; all robot actions are recorded to the Nomagic Cloud to continually improve its models. The company is backed by Khosla Ventures. Public developer documentation for these APIs is not published; integration is arranged directly with Nomagic.

providers.name: Pax
providers.description: Pax (Pax AI) is a San Francisco-based artificial intelligence company that automates U.S. duty drawback claims, letting importers, retailers, and manufacturers reclaim overpaid tariffs and import duties. Branding itself the "AI Broker for Tariff Refunds" and "TurboTax for import duty rebate," Pax uses proprietary AI to automate data extraction, validation, transaction matching, refund calculation, and electronic claim submission to U.S. Customs and Border Protection with minimal manual effort. Founded by former duty-drawback experts and engineers from Charter Brokerage, MIT, Amazon, Flexport, and Brex, Pax is backed by Y Combinator, Initialized Capital, General Catalyst, Flexport, Soma Capital, Basis Set Ventures, and others. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Pickle Robot
providers.description: Pickle Robot builds Physical AI systems for supply chain automation, best known for autonomous truck- and container-unloading robots that handle non-palletized, floor-loaded freight. Its Dill Autonomy Engine (DAE) pairs classical optimal control with generative AI and foundation models, driving an industrial arm with vision, LiDAR, and an air-suction gripper to unload 400-1,500 cases per hour.
